### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 源文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `96245b908e68797c4c57651935fd81cb45d384588ef015f891ef52a2f11a0eda`)

```text
/-- A composite number `a` is Carmichael if and only if it is squarefree
and, for all prime `p` dividing `a`, we have `p - 1 ∣ a - 1`. -/
```

#### Lean 声明 / Lean declaration (SHA-256 `64c0f32cbbe93fe6d41b7cca1aaa61fa0737562c997ef2f28eb249fe2e1d34f4`)

```lean
theorem korselts_criterion (a : ℕ) (ha₁ : a.Composite) :
    IsCarmichael a ↔ Squarefree a ∧
      ∀ p, p.Prime → p ∣ a → (p - 1 : ℕ) ∣ (a - 1 : ℕ)
```

#### 精确声明类型 / Exact declaration type (SHA-256 `601431ed5023bfb302914b25b14757f0e6f4edc1e0b38d035f6ad6f1abb6f91d`)

```lean
(a : ℕ) (ha₁ : a.Composite) :
    IsCarmichael a ↔ Squarefree a ∧
      ∀ p, p.Prime → p ∣ a → (p - 1 : ℕ) ∣ (a - 1 : ℕ)
```

```text
/-- An equivalent definition of a regular prime `p` is that it does not divide the numerator of the
```

```text
/--
Selfridge's test variant:
Let $p$ be an odd number, with $p \equiv \pm 1 \pmod{5}$, $2^{p-1} \equiv 1 \pmod{p}$
```

#### 源文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `c219212794996c192b8893ae2ed62bc76899a53cc04bfc1ef0412732a4c81002`)

```text
/--
Selfridge's test variant:
Let $p$ be an odd number, with $p \equiv \pm 1 \pmod{5}$, $2^{p-1} \equiv 1 \pmod{p}$
and $F_{p-1} \equiv 0 \pmod{p}$, then $p$ is a prime number.

The number $6601$ is a conterexample to this test satisfying $6601 ≡ 1 \mod 5$
-/
```

```lean
theorem selfridge_conjecture.variants.pseudo_counterexample :
    IsPseudoSelfridge 6601 ∧ ¬ (6601).Prime ∧ 6601 ≡ 1 [MOD 5]
```

#### 精确声明类型 / Exact declaration type (SHA-256 `c5183f2701ecaa4594ccaaf8229d367477fcab0a247d6f2269f304a6ec5f3c1f`)

```text
/--

```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 源文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `e8a263fe2c5b61201ba5b3fc21dbe9434dde9c2988f06d584ce455f2d69f9012`)

```text
/--
Wolstenholme's theorem states that any prime $p > 3$ satisfies $\binom{2p-1}{p-1} \equiv 1 (\pmod{p^3})$.

Formal proof linked here provided by AlphaProof.
*Reference:* [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wolstenholme%27s_theorem)
-/
```

#### Lean 声明 / Lean declaration (SHA-256 `646e8b1e50b51b77ca67ebd3e2ef3446734cde8048a6d9f8d5b1788e90a53ebb`)

```lean
theorem wolstenholme_theorem (p : ℕ) (h : p > 3) (hp : Nat.Prime p) :
    (2 * p - 1).choose (p - 1) ≡ 1 [MOD p ^ 3]
```

#### 精确声明类型 / Exact declaration type (SHA-256 `d4258ca4e34d46989af0e2f963f660332c79ee76b1ed67f4403db946e7e132ec`)

```lean
(p : ℕ) (h : p > 3) (hp : Nat.Prime p) :
    (2 * p - 1).choose (p - 1) ≡ 1 [MOD p ^ 3]
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
Structure theorem for finitely generated modules over a principal ideal domain
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `603df22990a4b4323f83f2e4a1d8129d9d83d2aec9642fe437697c9655105bb1`)

```text
**Structure theorem of finitely generated modules over a PID** : A finitely generated
module over a PID is isomorphic to the product of a free module and a direct sum of some
`R ⧸ R ∙ (p i ^ e i)` where the `p i ^ e i` are prime powers. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `e9427bc40e36c52167ce144b18aa7c17f258465853ef54a7b6425f3967a7419c`)

```lean
∀ (R : Type u) [inst : CommRing R] [IsPrincipalIdealRing R] (M : Type v) [inst_2 : AddCommGroup M]
  [inst_3 : _root_.Module R M] [IsDomain R] [h' : Module.Finite R M],
  ∃ n ι x p,
    ∃ (_ : ∀ (i : ι), Irreducible (p i)), ∃ e, Nonempty (M ≃ₗ[R] (Fin n →₀ R) × DirectSum ι fun i => R ⧸ R ∙ p i ^ e i)
```

```text
**Dirichlet's Theorem** on primes in arithmetic progression: if `q` is a positive
integer and `a : ZMod q` is a unit, then there are infinitely many prime numbers `p`

```

```text
The *open mapping theorem* for holomorphic functions, global version: if a function `g : E → ℂ`
is analytic on a connected set `U`, then either it is constant on `U`, or it is open on `U` (in the
sense that it maps any open set contained in `U` to an open set in `ℂ`). 
```

```lean
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℂ E] {U : Set E} {g : E → ℂ},
  AnalyticOnNhd ℂ g U → IsPreconnected U → (∃ w, ∀ z ∈ U, g z = w) ∨ ∀ s ⊆ U, IsOpen s → IsOpen (g '' s)
```

```text
*Dirichlet's approximation theorem:*
For any real number `ξ` and positive natural `n`, there are integers `j` and `k`,
with `0 < k ≤ n` and `|k*ξ - j| ≤ 1/(n+1)`.
```


#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `368c4ac0c50d17ada308e903ff69ceec2f9d230db8e6e11508cdb5c1f67ee212`)

```text
*Dirichlet's approximation theorem:*
For any real number `ξ` and positive natural `n`, there is a fraction `q`
such that `q.den ≤ n` and `|ξ - q| ≤ 1/((n+1)*q.den)`.

See also `AddCircle.exists_norm_nsmul_le`. 
```


#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `cb0546cb866de2da04e2b32581a89b2c8f3e7e41896347d8895fbb99be4579b5`)

```text
**Fundamental theorem of calculus-2**: If `f : ℝ → E` is continuous on `[a, b]` (where `a ≤ b`)
and has a right derivative at `f' x` for all `x` in `(a, b)`, and `f'` is integrable on `[a, b]`,
then `∫ y in a..b, f' y` equals `f b - f a`. 
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `309b302beb6c17fed8a9a726277904db8576020d1d0f30bdba18714ec57b195c`)

```text
**Fundamental theorem of calculus-1**, strict differentiability in the right endpoint.

If `f : ℝ → E` is integrable on `a..b` and `f x` has a finite limit `c` almost surely at `b`, then
`u ↦ ∫ x in a..u, f x` has derivative `c` at `b` in the sense of strict differentiability. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `291962edf1261d91a3f755652117da5686e80070571ff9db9e9ce1f1bca09c07`)

```lean
∀ {E : Type u_3} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] {f : ℝ → E} {c : E}
  {a b : ℝ},
  IntervalIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume a b →
    StronglyMeasurableAtFilter f (nhds b) MeasureTheory.volume →
      Filter.Tendsto f (nhds b ⊓ MeasureTheory.ae MeasureTheory.volume) (nhds c) →
        HasStrictDerivAt (fun u => ∫ (x : ℝ) in a..u, f x) c b
```

```text
**Weierstrass preparation theorem** ([washington_cyclotomic], Theorem 7.3):
let `g` be a power series over a complete local ring,
such that its image in the residue field is not zero. Then there exists a distinguished
polynomial `f` and a power series `h` which is a unit, such that `g = f * h`. 
```

```lean
  {g : PowerSeries A}, (PowerSeries.map (IsLocalRing.residue A)) g ≠ 0 → ∃ f h, g.IsWeierstrassFactorization f h
```

```text
**Lebesgue dominated convergence theorem** provides sufficient conditions under which almost
everywhere convergence of a sequence of functions implies the convergence of their integrals.
We could weaken the condition `bound_integrable` to require `HasFiniteIntegral bound μ` instead
(i.e. not requiring that `bound` is measurable), but in all applications proving integrability
is easier. 
```

```lean
  (∀ (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F n) μ) →

      (∀ (n : ℕ), ∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, ‖F n a‖ ≤ bound a) →
        (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => F n a) Filter.atTop (nhds (f a))) →
```

```text
**Birkhoff's theorem**
The set of doubly stochastic matrices is the convex hull of the permutation matrices.  Note
`exists_eq_sum_perm_of_mem_doublyStochastic` gives a convex weighting of each permutation matrix
directly.  To show `doublyStochastic n` is convex, use `convex_doublyStochastic`.
```

```lean
  [inst_4 : IsStrictOrderedRing R], ↑(doublyStochastic R n) = (convexHull R) {x | ∃ σ, Equiv.Perm.permMatrix R σ = x}
```

```text
Besicovitch covering theorem
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `39c29df30c09bf0093a466a4a3b78c864e636c01e719ece064f2970df2494b38`)

```text
The measurable **Besicovitch covering theorem**.

Assume that, for any `x` in a set `s`, one is given a set of admissible closed balls centered at
`x`, with arbitrarily small radii. Then there exists a disjoint covering of almost all `s` by
admissible closed balls centered at some points of `s`. We can even require that the radius at `x`
is bounded by a given function `R x`. (Take `R = 1` if you don't need this additional feature).

This version requires the underlying measure to be sigma-finite, and the space to have the
Besicovitch covering property (which is satisfied for instance by normed real vector spaces).
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `9b88488af5af5a2d3bd29474feab233baea1f50ed690769587d154380b84e1dc`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace α] [SecondCountableTopology α] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace α]
  [OpensMeasurableSpace α] [HasBesicovitchCovering α] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) [MeasureTheory.SFinite μ]
  (f : α → Set ℝ) (s : Set α),
  (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ δ > 0, (f x ∩ Set.Ioo 0 δ).Nonempty) →
    ∀ (R : α → ℝ),
      (∀ x ∈ s, 0 < R x) →
        ∃ t r,
          t.Countable ∧
            t ⊆ s ∧
              (∀ x ∈ t, r x ∈ f x ∩ Set.Ioo 0 (R x)) ∧
                μ (s \ ⋃ x ∈ t, Metric.closedBall x (r x)) = 0 ∧ t.PairwiseDisjoint fun x => Metric.closedBall x (r x)
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `27c7a81781e906dd5f317126adea816048e34e876231eab43828116f8e73b77f`)

```text
A bounded convergence theorem for a finite measure:
If a sequence of bounded continuous non-negative functions are uniformly bounded by a constant
and tend pointwise to a limit, then their integrals (`MeasureTheory.lintegral`) against the finite
measure tend to the integral of the limit.

A related result with more general assumptions is
`MeasureTheory.tendsto_lintegral_nn_filter_of_le_const`.
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `c98bc88223e29f9ae6f61693c0f56b15828e94c05e0ea5e57c34d57a68d6f75c`)

```lean
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Ω] [OpensMeasurableSpace Ω]
  (μ : MeasureTheory.FiniteMeasure Ω) {fs : ℕ → BoundedContinuousFunction Ω NNReal} {c : NNReal},
  (∀ (n : ℕ) (ω : Ω), (fs n) ω ≤ c) →
    ∀ {f : Ω → NNReal},
      (∀ (ω : Ω), Filter.Tendsto (fun n => (fs n) ω) Filter.atTop (nhds (f ω))) →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∫⁻ (ω : Ω), ↑((fs n) ω) ∂↑μ) Filter.atTop (nhds (∫⁻ (ω : Ω), ↑(f ω) ∂↑μ))
```

```text
Bounded convergence theorem
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `5644c9253294ab7934f4f81ec2e6f6e60c579300a4a147c0b7500d5354845f0d`)

```text
A bounded convergence theorem for a finite measure:
If bounded continuous non-negative functions are uniformly bounded by a constant and tend to a
limit, then their integrals against the finite measure tend to the integral of the limit.
This formulation assumes:
* the functions tend to a limit along a countably generated filter;
* the limit is in the almost everywhere sense;
* boundedness holds almost everywhere;
* integration is `MeasureTheory.lintegral`, i.e., the functions and their integrals are
  `ℝ≥0∞`-valued.
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `2c18641e577a634ae65a16b6d1973f3d9029dee4bdb3948a63bdfaf809dd9542`)

```lean
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : TopologicalSpace Ω] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace Ω] [OpensMeasurableSpace Ω] {ι : Type u_2}
  {L : Filter ι} [L.IsCountablyGenerated] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω) [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ]
  {fs : ι → BoundedContinuousFunction Ω NNReal} {c : NNReal},
  (∀ᶠ (i : ι) in L, ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, (fs i) ω ≤ c) →
    ∀ {f : Ω → NNReal},
      (∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ, Filter.Tendsto (fun i => (fs i) ω) L (nhds (f ω))) →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun i => ∫⁻ (ω : Ω), ↑((fs i) ω) ∂μ) L (nhds (∫⁻ (ω : Ω), ↑(f ω) ∂μ))
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
Borel–Carathéodory theorem
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `5cf0dfa6db80f1c8e53559fd2720f62dececcec2e743354702492bfc6c9e1efe`)

```text
**Borel-Carathéodory theorem**.

If `f` is analytic on the open ball `‖z‖ < R` and satisfies `(f z).re ≤ M` for all such `z`,
then `‖f z‖ ≤ 2 * M * ‖z‖ / (R - ‖z‖) + ‖f 0‖ * (R + ‖z‖) / (R - ‖z‖)` for all `‖z‖ < R`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `7d81aeaa2e07e3c5d3f1a5c018a87a2356a0cac90e45312f95fc6c031a651d90`)

```lean
∀ {f : ℂ → ℂ} {M R : ℝ} {z : ℂ},
  0 < M →
    DifferentiableOn ℂ f (Metric.ball 0 R) →
      Set.MapsTo f (Metric.ball 0 R) {z | z.re ≤ M} →
        0 < R → z ∈ Metric.ball 0 R → ‖f z‖ ≤ 2 * M * ‖z‖ / (R - ‖z‖) + ‖f 0‖ * (R + ‖z‖) / (R - ‖z‖)
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `47a715d5819c9ead7911bd45c48de03b2c2ffbc36385d1173b5cdd9e354ecfff`)

```text
M. **Riesz extension theorem**: given a convex cone `s` in a vector space `E`, a submodule `p`,
and a linear `f : p → ℝ`, assume that `f` is nonnegative on `p ∩ s` and `p + s = E`. Then
there exists a globally defined linear function `g : E → ℝ` that agrees with `f` on `p`,
and is nonnegative on `s`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `014c8c4d51f951f0db37e0ecae85e5d60f37d3bfa88e479af88e5eae78cbbe7f`)

```lean
∀ {E : Type u_2} [inst : AddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : _root_.Module ℝ E] (s : ConvexCone ℝ E) (f : E →ₗ.[ℝ] ℝ),
  (∀ (x : ↥f.domain), ↑x ∈ s → 0 ≤ ↑f x) →
    (∀ (y : E), ∃ x, ↑x + y ∈ s) → ∃ g, (∀ (x : ↥f.domain), g ↑x = ↑f x) ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, 0 ≤ g x
```

```text
**Existence of minimizers**, aka the **Hilbert projection theorem**.

Let `u` be a point in a real inner product space, and let `K` be a nonempty complete convex subset.
Then there exists a (unique) `v` in `K` that minimizes the distance `‖u - v‖` to `u`. 
```

```lean
∀ {F : Type u_3} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ F] {K : Set F},
  K.Nonempty → IsComplete K → Convex ℝ K → ∀ (u : F), ∃ v ∈ K, ‖u - v‖ = ⨅ w, ‖u - ↑w‖
```

```text
The **Erdős–Ginzburg–Ziv theorem** for `ℤ/nℤ`.

Any sequence of at least `2 * n - 1` elements of `ZMod n` contains a subsequence of `n` elements
whose sum is zero. 
```


### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
Lebesgue's density theorem
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `5bce6e2068da761cdf39f93d9955f7892941b321ee19485c2b693a2bd43d01cd`)

```text
Given an arbitrary set `s`, then `μ (s ∩ closedBall x r) / μ (closedBall x r)` converges
to `1` when `r` tends to `0`, for almost every `x` in `s`.
This shows that almost every point of `s` is a Lebesgue density point for `s`.
A stronger version holds for measurable sets, see `ae_tendsto_measure_inter_div_of_measurableSet`.

See also `IsUnifLocDoublingMeasure.ae_tendsto_measure_inter_div`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `ce162e92ed536422b6068aa3c76d32998ecf45b72147b3aa3e9b34de95710682`)

```lean
∀ {β : Type u} [inst : MetricSpace β] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace β] [BorelSpace β] [SecondCountableTopology β]
  [HasBesicovitchCovering β] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure β) [MeasureTheory.IsLocallyFiniteMeasure μ] (s : Set β),
  ∀ᵐ (x : β) ∂μ.restrict s,
    Filter.Tendsto (fun r => μ (s ∩ Metric.closedBall x r) / μ (Metric.closedBall x r)) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0))
      (nhds 1)
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `3fd46e42bbc3123b7affa6557fb645fee81800a06415bd6f3921154ba5392127`)

```text
**Vitali's convergence theorem** (non-finite measure version).

A sequence of functions `f` converges to `g` in Lp
if and only if it is uniformly integrable, uniformly tight and converges to `g` in measure. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `035bc78f2aec3ee0282d71bc566a9a10477f35306afc8260af028e61356a3d28`)

```lean
  {p : ENNReal} {f : ℕ → α → β} {g : α → β},
  1 ≤ p →
    p ≠ ⊤ →
      (∀ (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.MemLp (f n) p μ) →
        MeasureTheory.MemLp g p μ →
          (MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure μ f Filter.atTop g ∧
              MeasureTheory.UnifIntegrable f p μ ∧ MeasureTheory.UnifTight f p μ ↔
            Filter.Tendsto (fun n => MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (f n - g) p μ) Filter.atTop (nhds 0))
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `93bb8036973284770c3eac31a9235f7dc7ef903bb6858bd3c9ada477fb2b20e0`)

```text
Banach fixed-point theorem, contraction mapping theorem, `EMetricSpace` version.
A contracting map on a complete metric space has a fixed point.
We include more conclusions in this theorem to avoid proving them again later.

The main API for this theorem are the functions `efixedPoint` and `fixedPoint`,
and lemmas about these functions. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `45217c85afc1fad26eb0d2702128da280f9319ad269d291ed6be4894a35300e5`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : EMetricSpace α] {K : NNReal} {f : α → α} [CompleteSpace α],
  ContractingWith K f →
    ∀ (x : α),
      edist x (f x) ≠ ⊤ →
        ∃ y,
          Function.IsFixedPt f y ∧
            Filter.Tendsto (fun n => f^[n] x) Filter.atTop (nhds y) ∧
              ∀ (n : ℕ), edist (f^[n] x) y ≤ edist x (f x) * ↑K ^ n / (1 - ↑K)
```

```text
Phragmén–Lindelöf theorem
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `90e27b7762142a6d814f6cf9f03cf6aecdeb340945bd21cfdcc84a5a58b28b12`)

```text
**Phragmen-Lindelöf principle** in a strip `U = {z : ℂ | a < im z < b}`.
Let `f : ℂ → E` be a function such that

* `f` is differentiable on `U` and is continuous on its closure;
* `‖f z‖` is bounded from above by `A * exp(B * exp(c * |re z|))` on `U` for some `c < π / (b - a)`;
* `‖f z‖` is bounded from above by a constant `C` on the boundary of `U`.

Then `‖f z‖` is bounded by the same constant on the closed strip
`{z : ℂ | a ≤ im z ≤ b}`. Moreover, it suffices to verify the second assumption
only for sufficiently large values of `|re z|`.
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `172c5db510bec9c80e7aa0043fb81de00ab93a31bacdfe423d9e2acc21e0076a`)

```lean
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℂ E] {a b C : ℝ} {f : ℂ → E} {z : ℂ},
  DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Complex.im ⁻¹' Set.Ioo a b) →
    (∃ c < Real.pi / (b - a),
        ∃ B,
          f =O[Filter.comap (abs ∘ Complex.re) Filter.atTop ⊓ Filter.principal (Complex.im ⁻¹' Set.Ioo a b)] fun z =>
            Real.exp (B * Real.exp (c * |z.re|))) →
      (∀ (z : ℂ), z.im = a → ‖f z‖ ≤ C) → (∀ (z : ℂ), z.im = b → ‖f z‖ ≤ C) → a ≤ z.im → z.im ≤ b → ‖f z‖ ≤ C
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `aa0538d295fdc058f1bc1d18c461da555e87d70a056e0d1123221bd46619b1c0`)

```text
The **Chevalley–Warning theorem**, finitary version.
Let `(f i)` be a finite family of multivariate polynomials
in finitely many variables (`X s`, `s : σ`) over a finite field of characteristic `p`.
Assume that the sum of the total degrees of the `f i` is less than the cardinality of `σ`.
Then the number of common solutions of the `f i` is divisible by `p`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `eb72579d5efb7a88e09bccede0f6a990ce628a085de0998ffd3d7a4eb8010dcc`)

```lean
∀ {K : Type u_1} {σ : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : Fintype K] [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Fintype σ]
  [inst_3 : DecidableEq σ] [inst_4 : DecidableEq K] (p : ℕ) [CharP K p] {s : Finset ι} {f : ι → MvPolynomial σ K},
  ∑ i ∈ s, (f i).totalDegree < Fintype.card σ → p ∣ Fintype.card { x // ∀ i ∈ s, (MvPolynomial.eval x) (f i) = 0 }
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `c5e32bfe080346fadfc826c9e5c5f76cdc9f16fe4f205e8c46fef4f292179a87`)

```text
**Gershgorin's circle theorem**: for any eigenvalue `μ` of a square matrix `A`, there exists an
index `k` such that `μ` lies in the closed ball of center the diagonal term `A k k` and of
radius the sum of the norms `∑ j ≠ k, ‖A k j‖`. 
```

```lean

  {μ : K},
  Module.End.HasEigenvalue (Matrix.toLin' A) μ → ∃ k, μ ∈ Metric.closedBall (A k k) (∑ j ∈ Finset.univ.erase k, ‖A k j‖)
```

```text
**The optional stopping theorem** (fair game theorem): a strongly adapted integrable process `f`
is a submartingale if and only if for all bounded stopping times `τ` and `π` such that `τ ≤ π`, the
stopped value of `f` at `τ` has expectation smaller than its stopped value at `π`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `2675ee398cc0c3abf0f21a0fe820939f0f086b8035f43cb553931f6d3dcc0fbc`)

```lean
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {𝒢 : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0}
  {f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} [MeasureTheory.SigmaFiniteFiltration μ 𝒢],
  MeasureTheory.StronglyAdapted 𝒢 f →
    (∀ (i : ℕ), MeasureTheory.Integrable (f i) μ) →
      (MeasureTheory.Submartingale f 𝒢 μ ↔
        ∀ (τ π : Ω → ℕ∞),
          MeasureTheory.IsStoppingTime 𝒢 τ →
            MeasureTheory.IsStoppingTime 𝒢 π →
              τ ≤ π →
                (∃ N, ∀ (x : Ω), π x ≤ ↑N) →
                  ∫ (x : Ω), MeasureTheory.stoppedValue f τ x ∂μ ≤ ∫ (x : Ω), MeasureTheory.stoppedValue f π x ∂μ)
```

```text
The Löwenheim–Skolem Theorem: If `κ` is a cardinal greater than the cardinalities of `L`
and an infinite `L`-structure `M`, then there is an elementary embedding in the appropriate
direction between then `M` and a structure of cardinality `κ`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `2f26c3d030268322867ee22be027c6c34ed4af0eeb51b5d15579b014957111d7`)

```lean
∀ (L : FirstOrder.Language) (M : Type w') [inst : L.Structure M] [iM : Infinite M] (κ : Cardinal.{w}),
  Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ →
    Cardinal.lift.{w, max u v} L.card ≤ Cardinal.lift.{max u v, w} κ →
      ∃ N, (Nonempty (L.ElementaryEmbedding (↑N) M) ∨ Nonempty (L.ElementaryEmbedding M ↑N)) ∧ Cardinal.mk ↑N = κ
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `0b380b338a4d4ab3342a0505101087b575eca90eee3549ff7252d0a35a437f2b`)

```text
**Tietze extension theorem** for real-valued bounded continuous maps, a version with a closed
embedding and unbundled composition. If `e : C(X, Y)` is a closed embedding of a topological space
into a normal topological space and `f : X →ᵇ ℝ` is a bounded continuous function, then there exists
a bounded continuous function `g : Y →ᵇ ℝ` of the same norm such that `g ∘ e = f`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `28f942f014416203ed2a755270f93d3478464ae03a01110b3a76b82e6a7917dd`)

```lean
∀ {X : Type u_1} {Y : Type u_2} [inst : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace Y] [NormalSpace Y]
  (f : BoundedContinuousFunction X ℝ) {e : X → Y}, Topology.IsClosedEmbedding e → ∃ g, ‖g‖ = ‖f‖ ∧ ⇑g ∘ e = ⇑f
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `4326b4e2d3215bae6b55132f6ef34a223f2e3416d8b337e1a959ec7dae0ef5c1`)

```text
**Cauchy integral formula**: if `f : ℂ → ℂ` is continuous on a closed disc of radius `R` and is
complex differentiable at all but countably many points of its interior, then for any `w` in this
interior we have $\oint_{|z-c|=R}\frac{f(z)}{z-w}dz=2\pi i\,f(w)$.
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `d79f30802c99cbc27aacded7ebcad41b1089e4981b8e4e1c0b900c8af37d36ec`)

```lean
∀ {R : ℝ} {c w : ℂ} {s : Set ℂ},
  s.Countable →
    w ∈ Metric.ball c R →
      ∀ {f : ℂ → ℂ},
        ContinuousOn f (Metric.closedBall c R) →
          (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball c R \ s, DifferentiableAt ℂ f z) →
            ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, R), f z / (z - w) = 2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I * f w
```

```text
This is the version of **Hall's Marriage Theorem** in terms of indexed
families of finite sets `t : ι → Finset α`.  It states that there is a
set of distinct representatives if and only if every union of `k` of the
sets has at least `k` elements.

Recall that `s.biUnion t` is the union of all the sets `t i` for `i ∈ s`.

This theorem is bootstrapped from `Finset.all_card_le_biUnion_card_iff_exists_injective'`,
which has the additional constraint that `ι` is a `Fintype`.
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `8227c10e88d6de6bf827987a04a46e7c062dc778abfee7a7a2147a0509c1e902`)

```lean
∀ {ι : Type u} {α : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq α] (t : ι → Finset α),
  (∀ (s : Finset ι), s.card ≤ (s.biUnion t).card) ↔ ∃ f, Function.Injective f ∧ ∀ (x : ι), f x ∈ t x
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `cf2d8454ade8b6bd51d92342ebcf79bfbb059eb21c7ed9a2592b3b9cff8c840c`)

```text
The **Ax-Grothendieck** theorem

If `K` is an algebraically closed field, and `S : Set (ι → K)` is the `zeroLocus` of an ideal
of the multivariable polynomial ring, then any injective polynomial map `S → S`  is also
surjective on `S`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `017e0539cc5886af4ad285b26fecbeb242dfe91006c756d875c44c5347b5329e`)

```lean
∀ {K : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [IsAlgClosed K] [Finite ι] (I : Ideal (MvPolynomial ι K))
  (p : ι → MvPolynomial ι K),
  have S := MvPolynomial.zeroLocus K I;
  Set.MapsTo (fun v i => (MvPolynomial.eval v) (p i)) S S →
    Set.InjOn (fun v i => (MvPolynomial.eval v) (p i)) S → Set.SurjOn (fun v i => (MvPolynomial.eval v) (p i)) S S
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
Vitali covering theorem
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `d218c7e75073855ef870b991e84b359beb95a8646ac10a79942ee2274126dade`)

```text
The measurable **Vitali covering theorem**.

Assume one is given a family `t` of closed sets with nonempty interior, such that each `a ∈ t` is
included in a ball `B (x, r)` and covers a definite proportion of the ball `B (x, 3 r)` for a given
measure `μ` (think of the situation where `μ` is a doubling measure and `t` is a family of balls).
Consider a (possibly non-measurable) set `s` at which the family is fine, i.e., every point of `s`
belongs to arbitrarily small elements of `t`. Then one can extract from `t` a disjoint subfamily
that covers almost all `s`.

For more flexibility, we give a statement with a parameterized family of sets.
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `85c00d29c1bc66e5670d0759b02f1f459f4796b2dd20799e0a82add4b2c25daa`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [inst : PseudoMetricSpace α] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace α] [OpensMeasurableSpace α]
  [SecondCountableTopology α] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) [MeasureTheory.IsLocallyFiniteMeasure μ] (s : Set α)
  (t : Set ι) (C : NNReal) (r : ι → ℝ) (c : ι → α) (B : ι → Set α),
  (∀ a ∈ t, B a ⊆ Metric.closedBall (c a) (r a)) →
    (∀ a ∈ t, μ (Metric.closedBall (c a) (3 * r a)) ≤ ↑C * μ (B a)) →
      (∀ a ∈ t, (interior (B a)).Nonempty) →
        (∀ a ∈ t, IsClosed (B a)) →
          (∀ x ∈ s, ∀ ε > 0, ∃ a ∈ t, r a ≤ ε ∧ c a = x) →
            ∃ u ⊆ t, u.Countable ∧ u.PairwiseDisjoint B ∧ μ (s \ ⋃ a ∈ u, B a) = 0
```

```text
The **Kruskal-Katona theorem**.

Given a set family `𝒜` consisting of `r`-sets, and `𝒞` an initial segment of the colex order of the
same size, the shadow of `𝒞` is smaller than the shadow of `𝒜`. In particular, this gives that the
minimum shadow size is achieved by initial segments of colex. 
```

```lean
  Set.Sized r ↑𝒜 → 𝒞.card ≤ 𝒜.card → Finset.Colex.IsInitSeg 𝒞 r → 𝒞.shadow.card ≤ 𝒜.shadow.card
```

```text
**Hahn embedding theorem**

For a linearly ordered additive group `M`, there exists an injective `OrderAddMonoidHom` from `M` to
`Lex ℝ⟦FiniteArchimedeanClass M⟧` that sends each `a : M` to an element of the `a`-Archimedean class
of the Hahn series.
```

```lean
∀ (M : Type u_1) [inst : AddCommGroup M] [inst_1 : LinearOrder M] [inst_2 : IsOrderedAddMonoid M],
  ∃ f,
    Function.Injective ⇑f ∧
      ∀ (a : M), ArchimedeanClass.mk a = (FiniteArchimedeanClass.withTopOrderIso M) (ofLex (f a)).orderTop
```

```text
The **Erdős–Ko–Rado theorem**.

The maximum size of an intersecting family in `α` where all sets have size `r` is bounded by
`(card α - 1).choose (r - 1)`. This bound is sharp. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `98c4aca52d6dd7b8343b4c84a09d74dcaadb2cbe2a83cd59323cb15ae42fd961`)

```lean
∀ {n : ℕ} {𝒜 : Finset (Finset (Fin n))} {r : ℕ},
  (↑𝒜).Intersecting → Set.Sized r ↑𝒜 → r ≤ n / 2 → 𝒜.card ≤ (n - 1).choose (r - 1)
```

```text
**The Radon-Nikodym theorem**: Given two measures `μ` and `ν`, if
`HaveLebesgueDecomposition μ ν`, then `μ` is absolutely continuous to `ν` if and only if

```

```lean
  μ.AbsolutelyContinuous ν ↔ ν.withDensity (μ.rnDeriv ν) = μ
```

```text
Central limit theorem
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `e0bcc233d66973efacc9c64bb5ffb62aed21f336b6a5a666cfc15965ee9c7756`)

```text
**Central Limit Theorem:** Given a sequence of random variables `X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ` that are
independent, identically distributed with mean `μ` and variance `v`, and a random variable
`Y : Ω' → ℝ` following `gaussianReal 0 v`, the sequence
`n ↦ (√n)⁻¹ * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, X k ω - n * μ)` converges to `Y` in distribution. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `353cd4c2db16e11ec9fa80d4a21ee41dbf81000e5508cb3be12eba4c1531e20b`)

```lean
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {Ω' : Type u_2} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω} {mΩ' : MeasurableSpace Ω'} {P : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  {P' : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω'} {X : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} {Y : Ω' → ℝ} [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P]
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure P'],
  ProbabilityTheory.HasLaw Y (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 (ProbabilityTheory.variance (X 0) P).toNNReal) P' →
    MeasureTheory.MemLp (X 0) 2 P →
      ProbabilityTheory.iIndepFun X P →
        (∀ (i : ℕ), ProbabilityTheory.IdentDistrib (X i) (X 0) P P) →
          MeasureTheory.TendstoInDistribution
            (fun n ω => (√↑n)⁻¹ * (∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, X k ω - ↑n * ∫ (x : Ω), X 0 x ∂P)) Filter.atTop Y (fun x => P)
            P'
```

```text
**Poisson limit Theorem**: If `n * p n → r` as `n → ∞`. Then
`(n.choose k) * (p n)^k * (1 - p n)^(n - k) → exp (-r) * r^k / k!`.
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `35180220e3782da767c9286575b7fed5fd31df6970b2a436699559ec5e05c0ca`)

```lean
∀ {p : ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℝ} (k : ℕ),
  Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑n * p n) Filter.atTop (nhds r) →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k * (1 - p n) ^ (n - k)) Filter.atTop
      (nhds (Real.exp (-r) * r ^ k / ↑k.factorial))
```

```text
*Gauss-Lucas Theorem*: if $P$ is a nonconstant polynomial with complex coefficients,
then all zeros of $P'$ belong to the convex hull of the set of zeros of $P$.

This version provides explicit formulas for the coefficients of the convex combination.
See also `rootSet_derivative_subset_convexHull_rootSet` below.
```

```lean
∀ {P : Polynomial ℂ} {z : ℂ},
  0 < P.degree →
    Polynomial.eval z (Polynomial.derivative P) = 0 → z = P.roots.toFinset.centerMass (P.derivRootWeight z) id
```

```text
*Gauss-Lucas Theorem*: if $P$ is a nonconstant polynomial with complex coefficients,
then all zeros of $P'$ belong to the convex hull of the set of zeros of $P$.

See also `eq_centerMass_of_eval_derivative_eq_zero`
for a version that provides explicit coefficients of the convex combination.
```


```text
is large enough compared to the covolume of a lattice `L` of `E`, then it contains a non-zero
lattice point of `L`.
```

```text
**Ostrowski's Theorem** for `K(X)` with `K` any field:
A discrete valuation of rank 1 that is trivial on `K` is equivalent either to the valuation
at infinity or to the `p`-adic valuation for a unique maximal ideal `p` of `K[X]`. 
```

```lean
  {v : Valuation (RatFunc K) Γ} [v.IsRankOneDiscrete] [Valuation.IsTrivialOn K v] [inst_4 : DecidableEq (RatFunc K)],
  Xor' (v.IsEquiv (FunctionField.inftyValuation K))
    (∃! u, v.IsEquiv (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.valuation (RatFunc K) u))
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `0c010bb608b7b590c826d2440d2eb0d434aa2937fe59a65938edfcc2620d3077`)

```text
**Slutsky's theorem** for a continuous function: if `X n` converges in distribution to `Z`,
`Y n` converges in probability to a constant `c`, and `g` is a continuous function, then
`g (X n, Y n)` converges in distribution to `g (Z, c)`. 
```

```text
The *identity principle* for analytic functions, global version: if two functions are
analytic on a connected set `U` and coincide at points which accumulate to a point `z₀ ∈ U`, then
they coincide globally in `U`.
For higher-dimensional versions requiring that the functions coincide in a neighborhood of `z₀`,
see `AnalyticOnNhd.eqOn_of_preconnected_of_eventuallyEq`. 
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
Taylor's theorem
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `ca17a491d890266f3428d6915a1b67a2a5d0637019634944409a7a2d7bbf2e9d`)

```text
**Taylor's theorem** with the Cauchy form of the remainder.

We assume that `f` is `n+1`-times continuously differentiable on the closed set `Icc x₀ x` and
`n+1`-times differentiable on the open set `Ioo x₀ x`. Then there exists an `x' ∈ Ioo x₀ x` such
that
$$f(x) - (P_n f)(x₀, x) = \frac{f^{(n+1)}(x') (x - x')^n (x-x₀)}{n!},$$
where $P_n f$ denotes the Taylor polynomial of degree $n$ and $f^{(n+1)}$ is the $n+1$-th iterated
derivative. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `f4c442daad4396d2ae5b742cfaee0c66d63d7c74932bfc8b5a5c8641bfb8c6f2`)

```lean
∀ {f : ℝ → ℝ} {x x₀ : ℝ} {n : ℕ},
  x₀ < x →
    ContDiffOn ℝ (↑n) f (Set.Icc x₀ x) →
      DifferentiableOn ℝ (iteratedDerivWithin n f (Set.Icc x₀ x)) (Set.Ioo x₀ x) →
        ∃ x' ∈ Set.Ioo x₀ x,
          f x - taylorWithinEval f n (Set.Icc x₀ x) x₀ x =
            iteratedDerivWithin (n + 1) f (Set.Icc x₀ x) x' * (x - x') ^ n / ↑n.factorial * (x - x₀)
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
Egorov's theorem
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `a7c09252b18fc4531c5b94cf22bc3398028e38c045431d30df0fb9fa6408379a`)

```text
**Egorov's theorem**: If `f : ι → α → β` is a sequence of strongly measurable functions that
converges to `g : α → β` almost everywhere on a measurable set `s` of finite measure,
then for all `ε > 0`, there exists a subset `t ⊆ s` such that `μ t ≤ ε` and `f` converges to `g`
uniformly on `s \ t`. We require the index type `ι` to be countable, and usually `ι = ℕ`.

In other words, a sequence of almost everywhere convergent functions converges uniformly except on
an arbitrarily small set. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `a097e51420595c567284aad224220e852aab40887bd73fc9ad72ade660ba8f67`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} {m : MeasurableSpace α} [inst : PseudoEMetricSpace β]
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} [inst_1 : SemilatticeSup ι] [Nonempty ι] [Countable ι] {f : ι → α → β} {g : α → β}
  {s : Set α},
  (∀ (n : ι), MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable (f n)) →
    MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable g →
      MeasurableSet s →
        μ s ≠ ⊤ →
          (∀ᵐ (x : α) ∂μ, x ∈ s → Filter.Tendsto (fun n => f n x) Filter.atTop (nhds (g x))) →
            ∀ {ε : ℝ},
              0 < ε → ∃ t ⊆ s, MeasurableSet t ∧ μ t ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ε ∧ TendstoUniformlyOn f g Filter.atTop (s \ t)
```

```text
**Fubini's Theorem**: For integrable functions on `α × β`,
the Bochner integral of `f` is equal to the iterated Bochner integral.
`integrable_prod_iff` can be useful to show that the function in question in integrable.
`MeasureTheory.Integrable.integral_prod_right` is useful to show that the inner integral
of the right-hand side is integrable. 
```


#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `0976be4458a2b11bb0695385f8073cce6780ab059b1cccd49d4e1b8b070cf375`)

```text
A sum version of **Vieta's formula** for `Multiset`: the product of the linear terms `X + λ`
where `λ` runs through a multiset `s` is equal to a linear combination of the symmetric functions
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `6ec22bf19a018712377e94234e0a85eda739b65f789687f71297fe4d6f6997f2`)

```text
**Helly's theorem** for finite families of convex sets in its classical form.

If `F` is a family of `n` convex sets in a vector space of finite dimension `d`, with `n ≥ d + 1`,
and any `d + 1` sets of `F` intersect nontrivially, then all sets of `F` intersect nontrivially. 
```

```lean
  [inst_3 : AddCommGroup E] [inst_4 : _root_.Module 𝕜 E] [FiniteDimensional 𝕜 E] {F : ι → Set E} {s : Finset ι},
  Module.finrank 𝕜 E + 1 ≤ s.card →
    (∀ i ∈ s, Convex 𝕜 (F i)) →
      (∀ I ⊆ s, I.card = Module.finrank 𝕜 E + 1 → (⋂ i ∈ I, F i).Nonempty) → (⋂ i ∈ s, F i).Nonempty
```

```text
**Radon's theorem on convex sets**.

Any family `f` of affine dependent vectors contains a set `I` with the property that convex hulls of
`I` and `Iᶜ` intersect nontrivially.
In particular, any `d + 2` points in a `d`-dimensional space can be partitioned this way, since they
are affinely dependent (see `finrank_vectorSpan_le_iff_not_affineIndependent`). 
```

```lean
  ¬AffineIndependent 𝕜 f → ∃ I, ((convexHull 𝕜) (f '' I) ∩ (convexHull 𝕜) (f '' Iᶜ)).Nonempty
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `e494be64e020c14b813fc59021601a2be890f2ac8a3dce159891feb920534dac`)

```text
**Tutte's theorem**

A graph has a perfect matching if and only if: For every subset `u` of vertices, removing this
subset induces at most `u.ncard` components of odd size. This is formally stated using the
predicate `IsTutteViolator`, which is satisfied exactly when this condition does not hold. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `d876464caf73e1b340290bd6f62411fa79b0e3ea9a7c1a999f611325ddc970f5`)

```lean
∀ {V : Type u_1} {G : SimpleGraph V} [Finite V], (∃ M, M.IsPerfectMatching) ↔ ∀ (u : Set V), ¬G.IsTutteViolator u
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`ProperCone.hyperplane_separation'`: This variant of the [hyperplane separation theorem](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hyperplane_separation_theorem) states that given a nonempty, closed, convex cone `C` in a complete, real inner product space `E` and a point `b` disjoint from it, there is a vector `y` which separates `b` from `K` in the sense that for all points `x` in `K`, `0 ≤ ⟪x, y⟫_ℝ` and `⟪y, b⟫_ℝ < 0`. This is also a geometric interpretation of the [Farkas lemma](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Farkas%27_lemma#Geometric_interpretation).
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `c043d3eb42194f9ec4c848fda29fc6600bde5f9861003a70558ef68247201c3f`)

```text
Geometric interpretation of **Farkas' lemma**. Also stronger version of the
**Hahn-Banach separation theorem** for proper cones. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `b63b381d37d2958d071d1312e5a3d828bbc8f9e8d8263aea65689e15ac93e086`)

```lean
∀ {E : Type u_2} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [CompleteSpace E] {x₀ : E}
  (C : ProperCone ℝ E), x₀ ∉ C → ∃ y, (∀ x ∈ C, 0 ≤ inner ℝ x y) ∧ inner ℝ x₀ y < 0
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Finset.all_card_le_biUnion_card_iff_existsInjective'` is Hall's theorem with a finite index set.  This is elsewhere generalized to `Finset.all_card_le_biUnion_card_iff_existsInjective`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `3aee31551a10989aca9e600645a977d6cd0e262d3803cb118d9bc884477b8282`)

```text
This is the version of **Hall's Marriage Theorem** in terms of indexed
families of finite sets `t : ι → Finset α` with `ι` finite.
It states that there is a set of distinct representatives if and only
if every union of `k` of the sets has at least `k` elements.

See `Finset.all_card_le_biUnion_card_iff_exists_injective` for a version
where the `Finite ι` constraint is removed.
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `42f67e7b5729747746899f4fb969aaca80d5352e7e5ac385b40b7373fb42d525`)

```lean
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {α : Type u_2} [Finite ι] [inst : DecidableEq α] (t : ι → Finset α),
  (∀ (s : Finset ι), s.card ≤ (s.biUnion t).card) ↔ ∃ f, Function.Injective f ∧ ∀ (x : ι), f x ∈ t x
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`CircleDeg1Lift.semiconj_of_group_action_of_forall_translationNumber_eq`: let `f₁` and `f₂` be two actions of a group `G` on the circle by degree 1 maps (formally, `f₁` and `f₂` are two homomorphisms from `G →* CircleDeg1Lift`). If the translation numbers of `f₁ g` and `f₂ g` are equal to each other for all `g : G`, then these two actions are semiconjugate by some `F : CircleDeg1Lift`. This is a version of Proposition 5.4 from [Étienne Ghys, Groupes d'homéomorphismes du cercle et cohomologie bornée][ghys87:groupes].
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `fc2ab1451b35bec5a8b2c1c34b6b2d1e1225017bdb3ba2551b8265aaa0d7eb92`)

```text
Consider two actions `f₁ f₂ : G →* CircleDeg1Lift` of a group on the real line by lifts of
orientation-preserving circle homeomorphisms. Suppose that for each `g : G` the homeomorphisms
`f₁ g` and `f₂ g` have equal rotation numbers. Then there exists `F : CircleDeg1Lift` such that
`F * f₁ g = f₂ g * F` for all `g : G`.

This is a version of Proposition 5.4 from [Étienne Ghys, Groupes d'homéomorphismes du cercle et
cohomologie bornée][ghys87:groupes]. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `8e2063bb388865d23d34ecb71dd8f644260458ba016eaa9d94fd606cc3a7e009`)

```lean
∀ {G : Type u_1} [inst : Group G] (f₁ f₂ : G →* CircleDeg1Lift),
  (∀ (g : G), (f₁ g).translationNumber = (f₂ g).translationNumber) →
    ∃ F, ∀ (g : G), Function.Semiconj ⇑F ⇑(f₁ g) ⇑(f₂ g)
```


### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`NNReal.lintegral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq`  : ℝ≥0 functions. `ENNReal.lintegral_mul_norm_pow_le` is a variant where the exponents are not reciprocals: `∫ (f ^ p * g ^ q) ∂μ ≤ (∫ f ∂μ) ^ p * (∫ g ∂μ) ^ q` where `p, q ≥ 0` and `p + q = 1`. `ENNReal.lintegral_prod_norm_pow_le` generalizes this to a finite family of functions: `∫ (∏ i, f i ^ p i) ∂μ ≤ ∏ i, (∫ f i ∂μ) ^ p i` when the `p` is a collection of nonnegative weights with sum 1. Minkowski's inequality for the Lebesgue integral of measurable functions with `ℝ≥0∞` values: we prove `(∫ (f + g)^p ∂μ) ^ (1/p) ≤ (∫ f^p ∂μ) ^ (1/p) + (∫ g^p ∂μ) ^ (1/p)` for `1 ≤ p`.
```

```text
A different formulation of Hölder's inequality for two functions, with two exponents that sum to
1, instead of reciprocals of 
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`FirstOrder.Language.exists_elementarySubstructure_card_eq` is the Downward Löwenheim–Skolem theorem: If `s` is a set in an `L`-structure `M` and `κ` an infinite cardinal such that `max (#s, L.card) ≤ κ` and `κ ≤ # M`, then `M` has an elementary substructure containing `s` of cardinality `κ`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `f03c61136acf9da2af6aa28d2fbd5702d713e480d981eb7c1fb7867d8e972c97`)

```text
The **Downward Löwenheim–Skolem theorem** :
If `s` is a set in an `L`-structure `M` and `κ` an infinite cardinal such that
`max (#s, L.card) ≤ κ` and `κ ≤ # M`, then `M` has an elementary substructure containing `s` of
cardinality `κ`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `9e431252be6095f07cff39002ee37af02802729d4181142b5d33cd64dc6aab00`)

```lean
∀ (L : FirstOrder.Language) {M : Type w} [Nonempty M] [inst : L.Structure M] (s : Set M) (κ : Cardinal.{w'}),
  Cardinal.aleph0 ≤ κ →
    Cardinal.lift.{w', w} (Cardinal.mk ↑s) ≤ Cardinal.lift.{w, w'} κ →
      Cardinal.lift.{w', max u v} L.card ≤ Cardinal.lift.{max u v, w'} κ →
        Cardinal.lift.{w, w'} κ ≤ Cardinal.lift.{w', w} (Cardinal.mk M) →
          ∃ S, s ⊆ ↑S ∧ Cardinal.lift.{w', w} (Cardinal.mk ↥S) = Cardinal.lift.{w, w'} κ
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
Higman's Lemma, `Set.PartiallyWellOrderedOn.partiallyWellOrderedOn_sublistForall₂`, shows that if `r` is partially well-ordered on `s`, then `List.SublistForall₂` is partially well-ordered on the set of lists of elements of `s`. The result was originally published by Higman, but this proof more closely follows Nash-Williams.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `4956d833a3ae3917fa73f4e9ef3e13490224e583d6d59f41ebbfee842bb5965c`)

```text
Higman's Lemma, which states that for any reflexive, transitive relation `r` which is
partially well-ordered on a set `s`, the relation `List.SublistForall₂ r` is partially
well-ordered on the set of lists of elements of `s`. That relation is defined so that
`List.SublistForall₂ r l₁ l₂` whenever `l₁` related pointwise by `r` to a sublist of `l₂`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `220569f538122d245fca9d611b468a1d80527aef4b7e314639c08fe8583e3215`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_2} (r : α → α → Prop) [IsPreorder α r] {s : Set α},
  s.PartiallyWellOrderedOn r → {l | ∀ x ∈ l, x ∈ s}.PartiallyWellOrderedOn (List.SublistForall₂ r)
```

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`groupCohomology.isMulCoboundary₁_of_isMulCocycle₁_of_aut_to_units`: Noether's generalization of Hilbert's Theorem 90: for all $f: Aut_K(L) \to L^\times$ satisfying the 1-cocycle condition, there exists `β : Lˣ` such that $g(β)/β = f(g)$ for all `g : Aut_K(L)`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `eeea55a6efed955b2f8e23e12350c52c788fdb1a5968bc17baeaa962a07af5b8`)

```text
Noether's generalization of Hilbert's Theorem 90: given a finite extension of fields and a
function `f : Aut_K(L) → Lˣ` satisfying `f(gh) = g(f(h)) * f(g)` for all `g, h : Aut_K(L)`, there
exists `β : Lˣ` such that `g(β)/β = f(g)` for all `g : Aut_K(L).` 
```


### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Complex.circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul_of_differentiable_on_off_countable`, `Complex.two_pi_I_inv_smul_circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul_of_differentiable_on_off_countable` **Cauchy integral formula**: if `f : ℂ → E` is continuous on a closed disc of radius `R` and is complex differentiable on the corresponding open disc, then for any `w` in the corresponding open disc the integral of `(z - w)⁻¹ • f z` over the boundary of the disc is equal to `2πif(w)`. Two versions of the lemma put the multiplier `2πi` at the different sides of the equality.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `a24bc2cac850e330a5b42abf02cfb27c5c0605b38486dc182ef154d186c1db83`)

```text
**Cauchy integral formula**: if `f : ℂ → E` is continuous on a closed disc of radius `R` and is
complex differentiable at all but countably many points of its interior, then for any `w` in this
interior we have $\oint_{|z-c|=R}(z-w)^{-1}f(z)\,dz=2πif(w)$.
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `3d10f7f78b50eaffcf81060053170e09e776921c0cf4405e25566c82278a3a82`)

```lean
∀ {E : Type u} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E] {R : ℝ} {c w : ℂ} {f : ℂ → E}
  {s : Set ℂ},
  s.Countable →
    w ∈ Metric.ball c R →
      ContinuousOn f (Metric.closedBall c R) →
        (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R \ s, DifferentiableAt ℂ f x) →
          ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, R), (z - w)⁻¹ • f z = (2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I) • f w
```

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Combinatorics.Subspace.exists_mono_in_high_dimension`: The multidimensional Hales-Jewett theorem.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `796e3ec2bc928f21d3e881bc5dfdbcbda8b7e8f3fd1a663b3a5888ebcfda64a5`)

```text
The **multidimensional Hales-Jewett theorem**, aka **extended Hales-Jewett theorem**: For any
finite types `η`, `α` and `κ`, there exists a finite type `ι` such that whenever the hypercube
`ι → α` is `κ`-colored, there is a monochromatic combinatorial subspace of dimension `η`. 
```

```lean
  ∃ ι x, ∀ (C : (ι → α) → κ), ∃ l, Combinatorics.Subspace.IsMono C l
```

```text
`Nat.Partrec.Code.fixed_point`: Roger's fixed point theorem.
```

```text
**Roger's fixed-point theorem**: any total, computable `f` has a fixed point.
That is, under the interpretation given by `Nat.Partrec.Code.eval`, there is a code `c`
such that `c` and `f c` have the same evaluation.
```


```text
**Church-Rosser theorem** for word reduction: If `w1 w2 w3` are words such that `w1` reduces
to `w2` and `w3` respectively, then there is a word `w4` such that `w2` and `w3` reduce to `w4`
respectively. This is also known as Newman's diamond lemma. 
```


### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`NNReal.lintegral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq`  : ℝ≥0 functions. `ENNReal.lintegral_mul_norm_pow_le` is a variant where the exponents are not reciprocals: `∫ (f ^ p * g ^ q) ∂μ ≤ (∫ f ∂μ) ^ p * (∫ g ∂μ) ^ q` where `p, q ≥ 0` and `p + q = 1`. `ENNReal.lintegral_prod_norm_pow_le` generalizes this to a finite family of functions: `∫ (∏ i, f i ^ p i) ∂μ ≤ ∏ i, (∫ f i ∂μ) ^ p i` when the `p` is a collection of nonnegative weights with sum 1. Minkowski's inequality for the Lebesgue integral of measurable functions with `ℝ≥0∞` values: we prove `(∫ (f + g)^p ∂μ) ^ (1/p) ≤ (∫ f^p ∂μ) ^ (1/p) + (∫ g^p ∂μ) ^ (1/p)` for `1 ≤ p`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `ede343b77990f55e7339a9919dcd631928734d481fa608f664faa1c23e684f56`)

```text
A version of Hölder with multiple arguments 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `089df36a3b265d1550e7f3cb5b173222171bc4ab7a2754b3823ca9f7daca8b12`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} (s : Finset ι)
  {f : ι → α → ENNReal},
  (∀ i ∈ s, AEMeasurable (f i) μ) →
    ∀ {p : ι → ℝ},
      ∑ i ∈ s, p i = 1 →
        (∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i) → ∫⁻ (a : α), ∏ i ∈ s, f i a ^ p i ∂μ ≤ ∏ i ∈ s, (∫⁻ (a : α), f i a ∂μ) ^ p i
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Rat.finite_rat_abs_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq`, which states that the set above is finite when `ξ` is a rational number. Both statements are combined to give an equivalence, `Real.infinite_rat_abs_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq_iff_irrational`. There are two versions of Legendre's Theorem. One, `Real.exists_rat_eq_convergent`, uses `Real.convergent`, a simple recursive definition of the convergents that is also defined in this file, whereas the other, `Real.exists_convs_eq_rat` defined in the file `Mathlib/NumberTheory/DiophantineApproximation/ContinuedFractions.lean`, uses `GenContFract.convs` of `GenContFract.of ξ`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `ecfabfb16ac7e67faa36f8cfa1e5f4568c9bf600f579549dbd48289b00db814b`)

```text
The main result, *Legendre's Theorem* on rational approximation:
if `ξ` is a real number and `q` is a rational number such that `|ξ - q| < 1/(2*q.den^2)`,
then `q` is a convergent of the continued fraction expansion of `ξ`.
This version uses `Real.convergent`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `1689714dea233a5224e96677fa941cfc12ccf294f62e83096550c67feaad50ab`)

```lean
∀ {ξ : ℝ} {q : ℚ}, |ξ - ↑q| < 1 / (2 * ↑q.den ^ 2) → ∃ n, q = ξ.convergent n
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`MeasureTheory.Martingale.ae_eq_condExp_limitProcess`: part b the L¹ martingale convergence theorem: if `f` is a uniformly integrable martingale strongly adapted to the filtration `ℱ`, then `f n` equals `𝔼[g | ℱ n]` almost everywhere where `g` is the limiting process of `f`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `5a6a95e7406db4d927bc150c4fa8ef0f1ef10d8251ba6cdedc6197ee117458da`)

```text
Part b of the **L¹ martingale convergence theorem**: if `f` is a uniformly integrable martingale
strongly adapted to the filtration `ℱ`, then for all `n`, `f n` is almost everywhere equal to the
conditional expectation of its limiting process w.r.t. `ℱ n`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `0fe050ba88092758fb21cacc88bf882f55b0f37db26e0a7673dcfbb87b8e4445`)

```lean
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0}
  {f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ],
  MeasureTheory.Martingale f ℱ μ →
    MeasureTheory.UniformIntegrable f 1 μ → ∀ (n : ℕ), f n =ᵐ[μ] μ[MeasureTheory.Filtration.limitProcess f ℱ μ | ↑ℱ n]
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Submodule.exists_injOn_mkQ_image_span_eq_of_span_eq_map_mkQ_of_le_jacobson_bot` - Statement (8) in [Stacks: Nakayama's Lemma](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00DV). Note that a version of Statement (1) in [Stacks: Nakayama's Lemma](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00DV) can be found in `RingTheory.Finiteness` under the name `Submodule.exists_sub_one_mem_and_smul_eq_zero_of_fg_of_le_smul`
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `fb25fafc8f984546ba056c65575cd35020fd1d98b5368534fe0fd8b1e7e479ce`)

```text
**Nakayama's Lemma** - Statement (8) in
[Stacks 00DV](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00DV).

If `N` is a finitely generated `R`-submodule of `M`,
`I` is an ideal contained in the Jacobson radical of `R`,
`s` is a set of `M / (I • N)` that spans the quotient image of `N`,
then there exists a spanning set `t` of `N` in bijection with `s` via the quotient map.
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `fd45e5928cd4d9b977d3bbe533a2277ac9d71c44dd3c89028b149fe409d6af1e`)

```lean
∀ {R : Type u_1} {M : Type u_2} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_2 : _root_.Module R M] {I : Ideal R}
  {N : Submodule R M} (s : Set (M ⧸ I • N)),
  N.FG →
    I ≤ ⊥.jacobson →
      Submodule.span R s = Submodule.map (I • N).mkQ N →
        ∃ t, Set.InjOn (⇑(I • N).mkQ) t ∧ ⇑(I • N).mkQ '' t = s ∧ Submodule.span R t = N
```


```text
**Alexander's subbasis theorem**. Suppose `X` is a topological space with a subbasis `S` and `s` is
a subset of `X`. Then `s` is compact if for any open cover of `s` with all elements taken from `S`,
there is a finite subcover.
```


### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Complex.circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul_of_differentiable_on_off_countable`, `Complex.two_pi_I_inv_smul_circleIntegral_sub_inv_smul_of_differentiable_on_off_countable` **Cauchy integral formula**: if `f : ℂ → E` is continuous on a closed disc of radius `R` and is complex differentiable on the corresponding open disc, then for any `w` in the corresponding open disc the integral of `(z - w)⁻¹ • f z` over the boundary of the disc is equal to `2πif(w)`. Two versions of the lemma put the multiplier `2πi` at the different sides of the equality.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `3f3f860d181ad9ace3d0d987658c9448fc5fcfe91405db0d733248b66b2f0e63`)

```text
**Cauchy integral formula**: if `f : ℂ → E` is continuous on a closed disc of radius `R` and is
complex differentiable at all but countably many points of its interior, then for any `w` in this
interior we have $\frac{1}{2πi}\oint_{|z-c|=R}(z-w)^{-1}f(z)\,dz=f(w)$.
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `c676ec5c9d442d8e4e2aa5f7c0df6a8c68cfe9fc74af5045302ab0c965aa3c9d`)

```lean
∀ {E : Type u} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℂ E] [CompleteSpace E] {R : ℝ} {c w : ℂ} {f : ℂ → E}
  {s : Set ℂ},
  s.Countable →
    w ∈ Metric.ball c R →
      ContinuousOn f (Metric.closedBall c R) →
        (∀ x ∈ Metric.ball c R \ s, DifferentiableAt ℂ f x) →
          (2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I)⁻¹ • ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, R), (z - w)⁻¹ • f z = f w
```


### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`AlgebraicGeometry.SheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion.of_stalk_iso`: A (topological) open embedding between two sheafed spaces is an open immersion if all the stalk maps are isomorphisms.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `cb736d752ae3de8e538cdc7bf255e1c9915065075e4bc678aea18944f4b2b4b1`)

```text
Suppose `X Y : SheafedSpace C`, where `C` is a concrete category,
whose forgetful functor reflects isomorphisms, preserves limits and filtered colimits.
Then a morphism `X ⟶ Y` that is a topological open embedding
is an open immersion iff every stalk map is an iso.
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `4738951b72073a6be0a33d13684fd13b0a3379022f96b019158240a834f2542c`)

```lean
∀ {C : Type u} [inst : CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasLimits C]
  [inst_2 : CategoryTheory.Limits.HasColimits C] {FC : C → C → Type u_1} {CC : C → Type v}
  [inst_3 : (X Y : C) → FunLike (FC X Y) (CC X) (CC Y)] [instCC : CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory C FC]
  [(CategoryTheory.forget C).ReflectsIsomorphisms] [CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesLimits (CategoryTheory.forget C)]
  [CategoryTheory.Limits.PreservesFilteredColimits (CategoryTheory.forget C)] {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafedSpace C}
  (f : X ⟶ Y),
  Topology.IsOpenEmbedding ⇑(CategoryTheory.ConcreteCategory.hom f.hom.base) →
    ∀
      [H :
        ∀ (x : ↑↑X.toPresheafedSpace), CategoryTheory.IsIso (AlgebraicGeometry.PresheafedSpace.Hom.stalkMap f.hom x)],
      AlgebraicGeometry.SheafedSpace.IsOpenImmersion f
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`NNReal.lintegral_mul_le_Lp_mul_Lq`  : ℝ≥0 functions. `ENNReal.lintegral_mul_norm_pow_le` is a variant where the exponents are not reciprocals: `∫ (f ^ p * g ^ q) ∂μ ≤ (∫ f ∂μ) ^ p * (∫ g ∂μ) ^ q` where `p, q ≥ 0` and `p + q = 1`. `ENNReal.lintegral_prod_norm_pow_le` generalizes this to a finite family of functions: `∫ (∏ i, f i ^ p i) ∂μ ≤ ∏ i, (∫ f i ∂μ) ^ p i` when the `p` is a collection of nonnegative weights with sum 1. Minkowski's inequality for the Lebesgue integral of measurable functions with `ℝ≥0∞` values: we prove `(∫ (f + g)^p ∂μ) ^ (1/p) ≤ (∫ f^p ∂μ) ^ (1/p) + (∫ g^p ∂μ) ^ (1/p)` for `1 ≤ p`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `b0d0ceef7bc84e71eea4dcd5eaba0808b35c04ab7d495605eebd876384c0b217`)

```text
Hölder's inequality for functions `α → ℝ≥0`. The integral of the product of two functions
is bounded by the product of their `ℒp` and `ℒq` seminorms when `p` and `q` are conjugate
exponents. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `fbc5346936a4b9ba29a86d710066e6e7a06f3bb7c6a1ab8a0ea4665e5c71a4a0`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {p q : ℝ},
  p.HolderConjugate q →
    ∀ {f g : α → NNReal},
      AEMeasurable f μ →
        AEMeasurable g μ →
          ∫⁻ (a : α), ↑((f * g) a) ∂μ ≤ (∫⁻ (a : α), ↑(f a) ^ p ∂μ) ^ (1 / p) * (∫⁻ (a : α), ↑(g a) ^ q ∂μ) ^ (1 / q)
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Rat.finite_rat_abs_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq`, which states that the set above is finite when `ξ` is a rational number. Both statements are combined to give an equivalence, `Real.infinite_rat_abs_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq_iff_irrational`. There are two versions of Legendre's Theorem. One, `Real.exists_rat_eq_convergent`, uses `Real.convergent`, a simple recursive definition of the convergents that is also defined in this file, whereas the other, `Real.exists_convs_eq_rat` defined in the file `Mathlib/NumberTheory/DiophantineApproximation/ContinuedFractions.lean`, uses `GenContFract.convs` of `GenContFract.of ξ`.
```

```text
The set of good rational approximations to a real number `ξ` is infinite if and only if
`ξ` is irrational. 
```

```lean
∀ (ξ : ℝ), {q | |ξ - ↑q| < 1 / ↑q.den ^ 2}.Infinite ↔ Irrational ξ
```

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`ContinuousMap.tendsto_iff_forall_isCompact_tendstoUniformlyOn`: a sequence of functions `Fₙ` in `C(α, β)` converges in the compact-open topology to some `f` iff `Fₙ` converges to `f` uniformly on each compact subset `K` of `α`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `46e6c52d8b9fdd7753e02dbda50b038ef920ece6ee4e8a6b2c9c2e056eb66019`)

```text
Compact-open topology on `C(α, β)` agrees with the topology of uniform convergence on compacts:
a family of continuous functions `F i` tends to `f` in the compact-open topology
if and only if the `F i` tends to `f` uniformly on all compact sets. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `b43efc890e1d5b1c260110fbb5984916c6401316a4bf92c3f511d07cbc598b1c`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u₁} {β : Type u₂} [inst : TopologicalSpace α] [inst_1 : UniformSpace β] {ι : Type u₃} {p : Filter ι}
  {F : ι → C(α, β)} {f : C(α, β)},
  Filter.Tendsto F p (nhds f) ↔ ∀ (K : Set α), IsCompact K → TendstoUniformlyOn (fun i a => (F i) a) (⇑f) p K
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le`: this version assumes `fun x ↦ F x a` has derivative `F' x a` for `x` near `x₀` and `F' x` is bounded by an integrable function independent from `x` near `x₀`. `hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_lip` and `hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le` are versions of the above two results that assume `H = ℝ` or `H = ℂ` and use the high-school derivative `deriv` instead of Fréchet derivative `fderiv`. We also provide versions of these theorems for set integrals.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `21c9979f3da412c7dce5b199545a177c1a3e7a29c1556ed715b3537275e980fa`)

```text
Derivative under integral of `x ↦ ∫ F x a` at a given point `x₀ : ℝ`, assuming
`F x₀` is integrable, `x ↦ F x a` is differentiable on an interval around `x₀` for ae `a`
(with interval radius independent of `a`) with derivative uniformly bounded by an integrable
function, and `F x` is ae-measurable for `x` in a possibly smaller neighborhood of `x₀`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `a360cf9d0d58e5cfe8fce576a8ebc444f8c74334538d8d41d183b0a4ec6bb7cd`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {𝕜 : Type u_2} [inst_1 : RCLike 𝕜]
  {E : Type u_3} [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_3 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_4 : NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {bound : α → ℝ}
  {F : 𝕜 → α → E} {x₀ : 𝕜} {s : Set 𝕜},
  s ∈ nhds x₀ →
    (∀ᶠ (x : 𝕜) in nhds x₀, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F x) μ) →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (F x₀) μ →
        ∀ {F' : 𝕜 → α → E},
          MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F' x₀) μ →
            (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ s, ‖F' x a‖ ≤ bound a) →
              MeasureTheory.Integrable bound μ →
                (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ s, HasDerivAt (fun x => F x a) (F' x a) x) →
                  MeasureTheory.Integrable (F' x₀) μ ∧
                    HasDerivAt (fun n => ∫ (a : α), F n a ∂μ) (∫ (a : α), F' x₀ a ∂μ) x₀
```

- 固定源码 URL / Pinned source URL：`https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/8a178386ffc0f5fef0b77738bb5449d50efeea95/Mathlib/Combinatorics/Compactness.lean#L57-L79`

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Finset.rado_selection`: Given functions `g : Finset α → α → β` where `β` is finite, there exists a single function `χ : α → β` which is constructed out of `g`. More precisely, for each finite set `s`, there exists a larger set `t ⊇ s` such that `χ` and `g t` agree on `s`. In fact, we can more generally allow each `g s` to be a dependent function, as `(a : α) → β a`, so the type of `g` will be `Finset α → (a : α) → β a`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `9107ccd426b36665397196da31cf77b6ff8d1b1739fd098005e7492e4a35b18a`)

```text
Given a (dependent) function `g s : (a : α) → β a` for each finset `s` of `α`, provided that
each `β a` is finite, we can find another function `χ : (a : α) → β a` such that on every `s`,
there is some larger `t` such that `χ` agrees with `g t` on `s`.
Informally, we are stitching together the local functions `g s` into a global `χ` such that on
each `s`, `χ` can be expressed in terms of one of the `g`.
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `90ce1cf9468463925a3664b36e85d5789ab86472b9b4adffa96f1e821b887b12`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : α → Type u_2} [∀ (a : α), Finite (β a)] (g : Finset α → (a : α) → β a),
  ∃ χ, ∀ (s : Finset α), ∃ t, s ⊆ t ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, χ x = g t x
```

````text
`Submodule.LinearDisjoint.not_linearIndependent_pair_of_commute_of_flat`, `Submodule.LinearDisjoint.rank_inf_le_one_of_commute_of_flat`: if `M` and `N` are linearly disjoint, if one of `M` and `N` is flat, then any two commutative elements contained in the intersection of `M` and `N` are not `R`-linearly independent (namely, their span is not `R ^ 2`). In particular, if any two elements in the intersection of `M` and `N` are commutative, then the rank of the intersection of `M` and `N` is at most one. These results are stated using a bundled version (i.e. `a : ↥(M ⊓ N)`). If you want a non-bundled version (i.e. `a : S` with `ha : a ∈ M ⊓ N`), you may use `LinearIndependent.of_comp` and `FinVec.map_eq` (in `Mathlib/Data/Fin/Tuple/Reflection.lean`), see the following code snippet: ``` have h := H.not_linearIndependent_pair_of_commute_of_flat hf ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ hc contrapose! h refine .of_comp (M ⊓ N).subtype ?_ convert h exact (FinVec.map_eq _ _).symm ```
````

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `49841790465a17bc42b075927ef597a011e8326afafb42e68da16b1097e1aa8c`)

````text
This can be used to prove
```lean
example {f : α → β} (a₁ a₂ : α) : f ∘ ![a₁, a₂] = ![f a₁, f a₂] :=
  (map_eq _ _).symm
```
````

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`MulAction.set_mem_fixedBy_of_movedBy_subset` shows that if a set `s` is a superset of `(fixedBy α g)ᶜ`, then the group action of `g` cannot send elements of `s` outside of `s`. This is expressed as `s ∈ fixedBy (Set α) g`, and `MulAction.set_mem_fixedBy_iff` allows one to convert the relationship back to `g • x ∈ s ↔ x ∈ s`.
```

```text
moved by `g`.
```

```lean

  s ∈ MulAction.fixedBy (Set α) g ↔ ∀ (x : α), g • x ∈ s ↔ x ∈ s
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`MeasureTheory.lintegral_prod`: Tonelli's theorem. It states that for a measurable function `α × β → ℝ≥0∞` we have `∫⁻ z, f z ∂(μ.prod ν) = ∫⁻ x, ∫⁻ y, f (x, y) ∂ν ∂μ`. The version for functions `α → β → ℝ≥0∞` is reversed, and called `lintegral_lintegral`. Both versions have a variant with `_symm` appended, where the order of integration is reversed. The lemma `Measurable.lintegral_prod_right'` states that the inner integral of the right-hand side is measurable.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `2a63a2a7c16a4a975a0ad7849cfecb9d469763db3f69a6193801d2b24268b625`)

```text
The Lebesgue integral is measurable. This shows that the integrand of (the right-hand-side of)
Tonelli's theorem is measurable. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `2a869747b62bb45629c73b06ad4c1756f963d1bf61e69019a53bc790b7b91ad2`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace β] {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure β}
  [MeasureTheory.SFinite ν] {f : α × β → ENNReal}, Measurable f → Measurable fun x => ∫⁻ (y : β), f (x, y) ∂ν
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `1b9269afd89ad4861a5656eda3d6302b61723cfe4834eb5f6cce8972a7207261`)

```lean
∀ {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type u'},
  Cardinal.mk ((n : ℕ) × L.BoundedFormula α n) ≤
    max Cardinal.aleph0 (Cardinal.lift.{max u v, u'} (Cardinal.mk α) + Cardinal.lift.{u', max u v} L.card)
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Rat.finite_rat_abs_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq`, which states that the set above is finite when `ξ` is a rational number. Both statements are combined to give an equivalence, `Real.infinite_rat_abs_sub_lt_one_div_den_sq_iff_irrational`. There are two versions of Legendre's Theorem. One, `Real.exists_rat_eq_convergent`, uses `Real.convergent`, a simple recursive definition of the convergents that is also defined in this file, whereas the other, `Real.exists_convs_eq_rat` defined in the file `Mathlib/NumberTheory/DiophantineApproximation/ContinuedFractions.lean`, uses `GenContFract.convs` of `GenContFract.of ξ`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `12e69df23c11d4f30cb57abfff876b00e4ba802db119b83fe5c8c2eec986d6b4`)

```text
The main result, *Legendre's Theorem* on rational approximation:
if `ξ` is a real number and `q` is a rational number such that `|ξ - q| < 1/(2*q.den^2)`,
then `q` is a convergent of the continued fraction expansion of `ξ`.
This is the version using `GenContFract.convs`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `90d5009c1e28f1d311aefd68ab8f27c46b24ce1cad759332673b875715ae0e19`)

```lean
∀ {ξ : ℝ} {q : ℚ}, |ξ - ↑q| < 1 / (2 * ↑q.den ^ 2) → ∃ n, (GenContFract.of ξ).convs n = ↑q
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`IsClosed.Icc_subset_of_forall_mem_nhdsWithin` : “Continuous induction” principle; if `s ∩ [a, b]` is closed, `a ∈ s`, and for each `x ∈ [a, b) ∩ s` some of its right neighborhoods is included in `s`, then `[a, b] ⊆ s`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `27dbea1551e0378ebfdd7b9e8a0f939a07a476184840318a2265ee3739d9b5e2`)

```text
A "continuous induction principle" for a closed interval: if a set `s` meets `[a, b]`
on a closed subset, contains `a`, and for any `x ∈ s ∩ [a, b)` the set `s` includes some open
neighborhood of `x` within `(x, +∞)`, then `[a, b] ⊆ s`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `0e01965b9675e6d716392a358e16bb9dd9301809b26c135e2791fe552f4eca2b`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace α] [OrderTopology α]
  [DenselyOrdered α] {a b : α} {s : Set α},
  IsClosed (s ∩ Set.Icc a b) → a ∈ s → (∀ x ∈ s ∩ Set.Ico a b, s ∈ nhdsWithin x (Set.Ioi x)) → Set.Icc a b ⊆ s
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le`: this version assumes `fun x ↦ F x a` has derivative `F' x a` for `x` near `x₀` and `F' x` is bounded by an integrable function independent from `x` near `x₀`. `hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_lip` and `hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le` are versions of the above two results that assume `H = ℝ` or `H = ℂ` and use the high-school derivative `deriv` instead of Fréchet derivative `fderiv`. We also provide versions of these theorems for set integrals.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `a9f499ae0fd0de78f36e40148338cc0678eee1c40e9a13aa9fba660cc1ee6518`)

```text
Derivative under integral of `x ↦ ∫ F x a` at a given point `x₀ : 𝕜`, `𝕜 = ℝ` or `𝕜 = ℂ`,
assuming `F x₀` is integrable, `x ↦ F x a` is locally Lipschitz on a neighborhood of `x₀` for ae `a`
(with a neighborhood independent of `a`) with integrable Lipschitz bound, and `F x` is
ae-measurable for `x` in a possibly smaller neighborhood of `x₀`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `7af979ca3006b4cf0283591c097735dde5d1a98f5830b9e31c892d2a6c1be4a1`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α} {𝕜 : Type u_2} [inst_1 : RCLike 𝕜]
  {E : Type u_3} [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_3 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_4 : NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {bound : α → ℝ}
  {F : 𝕜 → α → E} {x₀ : 𝕜} {s : Set 𝕜} {F' : α → E},
  s ∈ nhds x₀ →
    (∀ᶠ (x : 𝕜) in nhds x₀, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F x) μ) →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (F x₀) μ →
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable F' μ →
          (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, LipschitzOnWith (Real.nnabs (bound a)) (fun x => F x a) s) →
            MeasureTheory.Integrable bound μ →
              (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, HasDerivAt (fun x => F x a) (F' a) x₀) →
                MeasureTheory.Integrable F' μ ∧ HasDerivAt (fun x => ∫ (a : α), F x a ∂μ) (∫ (a : α), F' a ∂μ) x₀
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`MulAction.set_mem_fixedBy_of_movedBy_subset` shows that if a set `s` is a superset of `(fixedBy α g)ᶜ`, then the group action of `g` cannot send elements of `s` outside of `s`. This is expressed as `s ∈ fixedBy (Set α) g`, and `MulAction.set_mem_fixedBy_iff` allows one to convert the relationship back to `g • x ∈ s ↔ x ∈ s`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `ddfff73c60dbad15f84f0a6694f426ce0d4c0c082445e54c6b4b826aeffa20aa`)

```text
If `(fixedBy α g)ᶜ ⊆ s`, then `g` cannot move a point of `s` outside of `s`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `eaf35004a861d9c63c04d63bdc122c4f47c9af3c5873ef54ed9177ac1f53989f`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} {G : Type u_2} [inst : Group G] [inst_1 : MulAction G α] {s : Set α} {g : G},
  (MulAction.fixedBy α g)ᶜ ⊆ s → s ∈ MulAction.fixedBy (Set α) g
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`blimsup_cthickening_mul_ae_eq`: the limsup of the closed thickening of a sequence of subsets of a metric space is unchanged almost everywhere for a uniformly locally doubling measure if the sequence of distances is multiplied by a positive scale factor. This is a generalisation of a result of Cassels, appearing as Lemma 9 on page 217 of [J.W.S. Cassels, *Some metrical theorems in Diophantine approximation. I*](cassels1950).
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `80bf75105b04798629092b801026f44e8901659e24af798bb11ed00d1f18e356`)

```text
Given a sequence of subsets `sᵢ` of a metric space, together with a sequence of radii `rᵢ`
such that `rᵢ → 0`, the set of points which belong to infinitely many of the closed
`rᵢ`-thickenings of `sᵢ` is unchanged almost everywhere for a uniformly locally doubling measure if
the `rᵢ` are all scaled by a positive constant.

This lemma is a generalisation of Lemma 9 appearing on page 217 of
[J.W.S. Cassels, *Some metrical theorems in Diophantine approximation. I*](cassels1950).

See also `blimsup_thickening_mul_ae_eq`.

NB: The `: Set α` type ascription is present because of
https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib/issues/16932. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `23be7b0efd7a474b9731335dbbedc2ca6b2c24813901a56fc19418d115da7f12`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : PseudoMetricSpace α] [SecondCountableTopology α] [inst_2 : MeasurableSpace α] [BorelSpace α]
  (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) [MeasureTheory.IsLocallyFiniteMeasure μ] [IsUnifLocDoublingMeasure μ] (p : ℕ → Prop)
  (s : ℕ → Set α) {M : ℝ},
  0 < M →
    ∀ (r : ℕ → ℝ),
      Filter.Tendsto r Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
        Filter.blimsup (fun i => Metric.cthickening (M * r i) (s i)) Filter.atTop p =ᵐ[μ]
          Filter.blimsup (fun i => Metric.cthickening (r i) (s i)) Filter.atTop p
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`MeasureTheory.Integrable.tendsto_ae_condExp`: part c the L¹ martingale convergence theorem: given a `⨆ n, ℱ n`-measurable function `g` where `ℱ` is a filtration, `𝔼[g | ℱ n]` converges almost everywhere to `g`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `fc7f641ac4a0358aef127238a1620a4b0461d5efbaf2fa8b4627297da51ba292`)

```text
Part c of the **L¹ martingale convergence theorem**: Given an integrable function `g` which
is measurable with respect to `⨆ n, ℱ n` where `ℱ` is a filtration, the martingale defined by
`𝔼[g | ℱ n]` converges almost everywhere to `g`.

This martingale also converges to `g` in L¹ and this result is provided by
`MeasureTheory.Integrable.tendsto_eLpNorm_condExp` 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `b83375ef7a1eb235bef43f61abb3ff29a6783c8855a1c13b57166a7c0df45050`)

```lean
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0}
  [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] {g : Ω → ℝ},
  MeasureTheory.Integrable g μ →
    MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable g →
      ∀ᵐ (x : Ω) ∂μ, Filter.Tendsto (fun n => μ[g | ↑ℱ n] x) Filter.atTop (nhds (g x))
```


### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`hasFDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_of_fderiv_le`: this version assumes `fun x ↦ F x a` has derivative `F' x a` for `x` near `x₀` and `F' x` is bounded by an integrable function independent from `x` near `x₀`. `hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_lip` and `hasDerivAt_integral_of_dominated_loc_of_deriv_le` are versions of the above two results that assume `H = ℝ` or `H = ℂ` and use the high-school derivative `deriv` instead of Fréchet derivative `fderiv`. We also provide versions of these theorems for set integrals.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `ea2f3bf4c4d3167670e4e0faeaff352ef104986760c5106e70a74658ba96f306`)

```text
Differentiation under integral of `x ↦ ∫ F x a` at a given point `x₀`, assuming
`F x₀` is integrable, `x ↦ F x a` is differentiable on a neighborhood of `x₀` for ae `a` with
derivative norm uniformly bounded by an integrable function (the neighborhood is independent
of `a`), and `F x` is ae-measurable for `x` in a possibly smaller neighborhood of `x₀`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `daa6e7933e30436b3a556fba35eac35383e8d1b1234dee7762df236bd94a608d`)

```lean
  {E : Type u_3} [inst_2 : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_3 : NormedSpace ℝ E] [inst_4 : NormedSpace 𝕜 E] {H : Type u_4}
  [inst_5 : NormedAddCommGroup H] [inst_6 : NormedSpace 𝕜 H] {F : H → α → E} {x₀ : H} {bound : α → ℝ} {s : Set H}
  {F' : H → α → H →L[𝕜] E},
  s ∈ nhds x₀ →
    (∀ᶠ (x : H) in nhds x₀, MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F x) μ) →
      MeasureTheory.Integrable (F x₀) μ →
        MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (F' x₀) μ →
          (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ s, ‖F' x a‖ ≤ bound a) →
            MeasureTheory.Integrable bound μ →
              (∀ᵐ (a : α) ∂μ, ∀ x ∈ s, HasFDerivAt (fun x => F x a) (F' x a) x) →
                HasFDerivAt (fun x => ∫ (a : α), F x a ∂μ) (∫ (a : α), F' x₀ a ∂μ) x₀
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Fintype.all_card_le_filter_rel_iff_exists_injective` is in terms of a relation `r : α → β → Prop` on finite types, with the Hall condition given in terms of `finset.univ.filter`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `f38290e4e3834c72ebdbdce860a2c2709153af069b63963f2a0a0a731e367dde`)

```text
This is a version of **Hall's Marriage Theorem** in terms of a relation to a finite type.
There is a transversal of the relation (an injective function `α → β` whose graph is a subrelation
of the relation) iff every subset of `k` terms of `α` is related to at least `k` terms of `β`.

It is like `Fintype.all_card_le_rel_image_card_iff_exists_injective` but uses `Finset.filter`
rather than `Rel.image`.
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `bcc081624d7874f2d5a4a9a6b6a25ef7a4b3aee5a496c1e46610430721e27332`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : Fintype β] (r : α → β → Prop) [inst_1 : DecidableRel r],
  (∀ (A : Finset α), A.card ≤ {b | ∃ a ∈ A, r a b}.card) ↔ ∃ f, Function.Injective f ∧ ∀ (x : α), r x (f x)
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`MeasureTheory.integral_prod`: Fubini's theorem. It states that for an integrable function `α × β → E` (where `E` is a second countable Banach space) we have `∫ z, f z ∂(μ.prod ν) = ∫ x, ∫ y, f (x, y) ∂ν ∂μ`. This theorem has the same variants as Tonelli's theorem (see `MeasureTheory.lintegral_prod`). The lemma `MeasureTheory.Integrable.integral_prod_right` states that the inner integral of the right-hand side is integrable.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `df77b825b6be27c2f669db2e09fe4ab8c8af64509ff27bf2cd6f753ce6444a08`)

```text
**Tonelli's Theorem**: For `ℝ≥0∞`-valued almost everywhere measurable functions on `α × β`,
the integral of `f` is equal to the iterated integral. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `9d7ce5bc1038d52732813c2e2eac44113c0cdda40ef5347a0be3454bcf910faa`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] [inst_1 : MeasurableSpace β] {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α}
  {ν : MeasureTheory.Measure β} [MeasureTheory.SFinite ν] (f : α × β → ENNReal),
  AEMeasurable f (μ.prod ν) → ∫⁻ (z : α × β), f z ∂μ.prod ν = ∫⁻ (x : α), ∫⁻ (y : β), f (x, y) ∂ν ∂μ
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`MeasureTheory.Integrable.tendsto_eLpNorm_condExp`: part c the L¹ martingale convergence theorem: given a `⨆ n, ℱ n`-measurable function `g` where `ℱ` is a filtration, `𝔼[g | ℱ n]` converges in L¹ to `g`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `54c7575f49578aadb7608acb8511f32b5870a6bee23bf23b59be7ba8876ffaa5`)

```text
Part c of the **L¹ martingale convergence theorem**: Given an integrable function `g` which
is measurable with respect to `⨆ n, ℱ n` where `ℱ` is a filtration, the martingale defined by
`𝔼[g | ℱ n]` converges in L¹ to `g`.

This martingale also converges to `g` almost everywhere and this result is provided by
`MeasureTheory.Integrable.tendsto_ae_condExp` 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `aa5ce249350894018132c98dfb568fa26818b3014fbca5813fc4290bd81ca12d`)

```lean
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0}
  [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] {g : Ω → ℝ},
  MeasureTheory.Integrable g μ →
    MeasureTheory.StronglyMeasurable g →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun n => MeasureTheory.eLpNorm (μ[g | ↑ℱ n] - g) 1 μ) Filter.atTop (nhds 0)
```
