### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`PhragmenLindelof.eq_zero_on_right_half_plane_of_superexponential_decay`, `PhragmenLindelof.eqOn_right_half_plane_of_superexponential_decay`: extensionality lemmas based on the Phragmen-Lindelöf principle in the right half-plane. In the case of the right half-plane, we prove a version of the Phragmen-Lindelöf principle that is useful for Ilyashenko's proof of the individual finiteness theorem (a polynomial vector field on the real plane has only finitely many limit cycles).
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `fa6614554bcde5c0827e929da64ccf73088238ebab80442aa70411169da0d8dd`)

```text
**Phragmen-Lindelöf principle** in the right half-plane. Let `f g : ℂ → E` be functions such
that

* `f` and `g` are differentiable in the open right half-plane and are continuous on its closure;
* `‖f z‖` and `‖g z‖` are bounded from above by `A * exp(B * ‖z‖ ^ c)` on the open right
  half-plane for some `c < 2`;
* `‖f z‖` and `‖g z‖` are bounded from above by constants on the imaginary axis;
* `f x - g x`, `x : ℝ`, tends to zero superexponentially fast as `x → ∞`:
  for any natural `n`, `exp (n * x) * ‖f x - g x‖` tends to zero as `x → ∞`.

Then `f` is equal to `g` on the closed right half-plane. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `5a1bb5ee8423b111995e4fad6e0da02a537a7c87e2919389df3300780a7b4325`)

```lean
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℂ E] {f g : ℂ → E},
  DiffContOnCl ℂ f {z | 0 < z.re} →
    DiffContOnCl ℂ g {z | 0 < z.re} →
      (∃ c < 2, ∃ B, f =O[Bornology.cobounded ℂ ⊓ Filter.principal {z | 0 < z.re}] fun z => Real.exp (B * ‖z‖ ^ c)) →
        (∃ c < 2, ∃ B, g =O[Bornology.cobounded ℂ ⊓ Filter.principal {z | 0 < z.re}] fun z => Real.exp (B * ‖z‖ ^ c)) →
          (Asymptotics.SuperpolynomialDecay Filter.atTop Real.exp fun x => ‖f ↑x - g ↑x‖) →
            (∃ C, ∀ (x : ℝ), ‖f (↑x * Complex.I)‖ ≤ C) →
              (∃ C, ∀ (x : ℝ), ‖g (↑x * Complex.I)‖ ≤ C) → Set.EqOn f g {z | 0 ≤ z.re}
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Fintype.all_card_le_rel_image_card_iff_exists_injective` is in terms of a relation `r : α → β → Prop` such that `R.image {a}` is a finite set for all `a : α`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `b928d404ecc46990af04c137a1036741fbcb16107deabc21a9f9e05e90e19969`)

```text
This is a version of **Hall's Marriage Theorem** in terms of a relation
between types `α` and `β` such that `α` is finite and the image of
each `x : α` is finite (it suffices for `β` to be finite; see
`Fintype.all_card_le_filter_rel_iff_exists_injective`).  There is
a transversal of the relation (an injective function `α → β` whose graph is
a subrelation of the relation) iff every subset of
`k` terms of `α` is related to at least `k` terms of `β`.

Note: if `[Fintype β]`, then there exist instances for `[∀ (a : α), Fintype (R.image {a})]`.
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `dc16e7c45b85932da4c50454e4313b5d8d584b31644c66844611f03d5bac75aa`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [inst : DecidableEq β] (R : SetRel α β) [inst_1 : (a : α) → Fintype ↑(R.image {a})],
  (∀ (A : Finset α), A.card ≤ Fintype.card ↑(R.image ↑A)) ↔ ∃ f, Function.Injective f ∧ ∀ (x : α), (x, f x) ∈ R
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

````text
`Submodule.LinearDisjoint.not_linearIndependent_pair_of_commute_of_flat`, `Submodule.LinearDisjoint.rank_inf_le_one_of_commute_of_flat`: if `M` and `N` are linearly disjoint, if one of `M` and `N` is flat, then any two commutative elements contained in the intersection of `M` and `N` are not `R`-linearly independent (namely, their span is not `R ^ 2`). In particular, if any two elements in the intersection of `M` and `N` are commutative, then the rank of the intersection of `M` and `N` is at most one. These results are stated using a bundled version (i.e. `a : ↥(M ⊓ N)`). If you want a non-bundled version (i.e. `a : S` with `ha : a ∈ M ⊓ N`), you may use `LinearIndependent.of_comp` and `FinVec.map_eq` (in `Mathlib/Data/Fin/Tuple/Reflection.lean`), see the following code snippet: ``` have h := H.not_linearIndependent_pair_of_commute_of_flat hf ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ hc contrapose! h refine .of_comp (M ⊓ N).subtype ?_ convert h exact (FinVec.map_eq _ _).symm ```
````

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `e32fb16d69daefff9cb96eaace697938ec29b216c85f21a41662430d1ceb7050`)

```text
If `M` and `N` are linearly disjoint, if one of `M` and `N` is flat, then any two commutative
elements of `↥(M ⊓ N)` are not `R`-linearly independent (namely, their span is not `R ^ 2`). 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `c5734a35c7214e391a5db1f7ecbd124eba629209c5ab67718ace219a7fbecec0`)

```lean
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {M N : Submodule R S},
  M.LinearDisjoint N →
    ∀ [Nontrivial R],
      Module.Flat R ↥M ∨ Module.Flat R ↥N → ∀ (a b : ↥(M ⊓ N)), Commute ↑a ↑b → ¬LinearIndependent R ![a, b]
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure_zero_or_top`: if `d₁ < d₂`, then for any `s`, either `μH[d₂] s = 0` or `μH[d₁] s = ∞`. Together with the previous lemma, this means that `μH[d] s` is equal to infinity on some ray `(-∞, D)` and is equal to zero on `(D, +∞)`, where `D` is a possibly infinite number called the *Hausdorff dimension* of `s`; `μH[D] s` can be zero, infinity, or anything in between.
```

```text
If `d₁ < d₂`, then for any set `s` we have either `μH[d₂] s = 0`, or `μH[d₁] s = ∞`. 
```

```lean

  d₁ < d₂ →
    ∀ (s : Set X), (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure d₂) s = 0 ∨ (MeasureTheory.Measure.hausdorffMeasure d₁) s = ⊤
```

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`completedRiemannZeta₀_one_sub`, `completedRiemannZeta_one_sub`, and `riemannZeta_one_sub` : functional equation relating values at `s` and `1 - s` For special-value formulae expressing `ζ (2 * k)` and `ζ (1 - 2 * k)` in terms of Bernoulli numbers see `Mathlib/NumberTheory/LSeries/HurwitzZetaValues.lean`. For computation of the constant term as `s → 1`, see `Mathlib/NumberTheory/Harmonic/ZetaAsymp.lean`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `7cad574bc607745a107d6ac913553e02f902acb0c55a94caccf876ccb7bfe54e`)

```text
Riemann zeta functional equation, formulated for `ζ`: if `1 - s ∉ ℕ`, then we have
`ζ (1 - s) = 2 ^ (1 - s) * π ^ (-s) * Γ s * sin (π * (1 - s) / 2) * ζ s`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `836337b669251c4b585ca8458a1e29041078c3b8de81b5b67e1aa65401143558`)

```lean
∀ {s : ℂ},
  (∀ (n : ℕ), s ≠ -↑n) →
    s ≠ 1 →
      riemannZeta (1 - s) = 2 * (2 * ↑Real.pi) ^ (-s) * Complex.Gamma s * Complex.cos (↑Real.pi * s / 2) * riemannZeta s
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`MeasureTheory.pdf.integral_pdf_smul` : Law of the unconscious statistician, i.e. if a random variable `X : Ω → E` has pdf `f`, then `𝔼(g(X)) = ∫ x, f x • g x dx` for all measurable `g : E → F`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `bdbe452a21abba1ca6d1d31f5bb14b059ed95963253676de0da8976c7f8ac5fc`)

```text
**The Law of the Unconscious Statistician**: Given a random variable `X` and a measurable
function `f`, `f ∘ X` is a random variable with expectation `∫ x, pdf X x • f x ∂μ`
where `μ` is a measure on the codomain of `X`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `d1950101f36c6a4702f067ad389812d1d0c45b4093415990bb710b16cda17136`)

```lean
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {E : Type u_2} [inst : MeasurableSpace E] {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {ℙ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω}
  {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure E} {F : Type u_3} [inst_1 : NormedAddCommGroup F] [inst_2 : NormedSpace ℝ F]
  [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure ℙ] {X : Ω → E} [MeasureTheory.HasPDF X ℙ μ] {f : E → F},
  MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable f μ →
    ∫ (x : E), (MeasureTheory.pdf X ℙ μ x).toReal • f x ∂μ = ∫ (x : Ω), f (X x) ∂ℙ
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Polynomial.roots_countP_pos_le_signVariations`. States that `P.roots.countP (0 < ·) ≤ P.signVariations`, so that positive roots are counted with multiplicity. It's currently proved for any `CommRing` with `IsStrictOrderedRing`. There is likely some correct statement in terms of a (noncommutative) `Ring`, but `Polynomial.roots` is only defined for commutative rings.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `16ca2e4fc83ad12a1eec318001d44cb092eb7fe8ba637d67a8305956bcb8d535`)

```text
**Descartes' Rule of Signs**: the number of positive roots is at most the number of sign
variations. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `bbed10973fdc1ac50f407ec13229b67ae544286bdc0a552dd538809dba79be23`)

```lean
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [inst_2 : IsStrictOrderedRing R] (P : Polynomial R),
  Multiset.countP (fun x => 0 < x) P.roots ≤ P.signVariations
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`PhragmenLindelof.eq_zero_on_right_half_plane_of_superexponential_decay`, `PhragmenLindelof.eqOn_right_half_plane_of_superexponential_decay`: extensionality lemmas based on the Phragmen-Lindelöf principle in the right half-plane. In the case of the right half-plane, we prove a version of the Phragmen-Lindelöf principle that is useful for Ilyashenko's proof of the individual finiteness theorem (a polynomial vector field on the real plane has only finitely many limit cycles).
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `c27a1b1e7b721ffce6b897a5ebb6cd4285fbc70614b48d3d929b95356eae9b3f`)

```text
**Phragmen-Lindelöf principle** in the right half-plane. Let `f : ℂ → E` be a function such that

* `f` is differentiable in the open right half-plane and is continuous on its closure;
* `‖f z‖` is bounded from above by `A * exp(B * ‖z‖ ^ c)` on the open right half-plane
  for some `c < 2`;
* `‖f z‖` is bounded from above by a constant on the imaginary axis;
* `f x`, `x : ℝ`, tends to zero superexponentially fast as `x → ∞`:
  for any natural `n`, `exp (n * x) * ‖f x‖` tends to zero as `x → ∞`.

Then `f` is equal to zero on the closed right half-plane. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `e6a072a52f917218f13f8d9a1a7a2e4cff8cfdb3f6bff61f70c601c8be756c40`)

```lean
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℂ E] {f : ℂ → E},
  DiffContOnCl ℂ f {z | 0 < z.re} →
    (∃ c < 2, ∃ B, f =O[Bornology.cobounded ℂ ⊓ Filter.principal {z | 0 < z.re}] fun z => Real.exp (B * ‖z‖ ^ c)) →
      (Asymptotics.SuperpolynomialDecay Filter.atTop Real.exp fun x => ‖f ↑x‖) →
        (∃ C, ∀ (x : ℝ), ‖f (↑x * Complex.I)‖ ≤ C) → Set.EqOn f 0 {z | 0 ≤ z.re}
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Finset.rado_selection_subtype`: A variant where `g` takes elements in the subtype.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `039ffde7d8ee4a4497d01af70f647ece69fd62b47675313f9cb1324180969b23`)

```text
Given a (dependent) function `g s : (a : s) → β a` for each finset `s` of `α`, provided that
each `β a` is finite, we can find another function `χ : (a : α) → β a` such that on every `s`,
there is some larger `t` such that `χ` agrees with `g t` on `s`.
Informally, we are stitching together the local functions `g s` into a global `χ` such that on
each `s`, `χ` can be expressed in terms of one of the `g`.
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `ca105fdf6cf54ea8d97deee1490147977ec7f88592c6a8bf77c099e8c2d4328b`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : α → Type u_2} [∀ (a : α), Finite (β a)] (g : (s : Finset α) → (a : ↥s) → β ↑a),
  ∃ χ, ∀ (s : Finset α), ∃ t, ∃ (hst : s ⊆ t), ∀ (x : ↥s), χ ↑x = g t (Set.inclusion hst x)
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

````text
`Submodule.LinearDisjoint.not_linearIndependent_pair_of_commute_of_flat`, `Submodule.LinearDisjoint.rank_inf_le_one_of_commute_of_flat`: if `M` and `N` are linearly disjoint, if one of `M` and `N` is flat, then any two commutative elements contained in the intersection of `M` and `N` are not `R`-linearly independent (namely, their span is not `R ^ 2`). In particular, if any two elements in the intersection of `M` and `N` are commutative, then the rank of the intersection of `M` and `N` is at most one. These results are stated using a bundled version (i.e. `a : ↥(M ⊓ N)`). If you want a non-bundled version (i.e. `a : S` with `ha : a ∈ M ⊓ N`), you may use `LinearIndependent.of_comp` and `FinVec.map_eq` (in `Mathlib/Data/Fin/Tuple/Reflection.lean`), see the following code snippet: ``` have h := H.not_linearIndependent_pair_of_commute_of_flat hf ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ hc contrapose! h refine .of_comp (M ⊓ N).subtype ?_ convert h exact (FinVec.map_eq _ _).symm ```
````

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `74ca8e4ba5a650d321aa2ce792641376c2abefd40b55e1ad1cada305b443f45f`)

```text
If `M` and `N` are linearly disjoint, if one of `M` and `N` is flat,
if any two elements of `↥(M ⊓ N)` are commutative, then the rank of `↥(M ⊓ N)` is at most one. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `adb6909d0bdffdfb4a518e4ba9689c4d43051c315cfcd04eddc10d7cb4ad5f73`)

```lean
∀ {R : Type u} {S : Type v} [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : Ring S] [inst_2 : Algebra R S] {M N : Submodule R S},
  M.LinearDisjoint N →
    Module.Flat R ↥M ∨ Module.Flat R ↥N → (∀ (m n : ↥(M ⊓ N)), Commute ↑m ↑n) → Module.rank R ↥(M ⊓ N) ≤ 1
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`MeasureTheory.lintegral_eq_lintegral_meas_le` and `MeasureTheory.lintegral_eq_lintegral_meas_lt`: The most common special cases of the layer cake formulas, stating that for a nonnegative function f we have ∫ f(ω) ∂μ(ω) = ∫ μ {ω | f(ω) ≥ t} dt and ∫ f(ω) ∂μ(ω) = ∫ μ {ω | f(ω) > t} dt, respectively.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `c6d4073d657858632c6eb314dc6451c528c7388e3d0888b3177db1b4126e0334`)

```text
The standard case of the layer cake formula / Cavalieri's principle / tail probability formula:

For a nonnegative function `f` on a measure space, the Lebesgue integral of `f` can
be written (roughly speaking) as: `∫⁻ f ∂μ = ∫⁻ t in 0..∞, μ {ω | f(ω) ≥ t}`.

See `MeasureTheory.lintegral_eq_lintegral_meas_lt` for a version with sets of the form
`{ω | f(ω) > t}` instead. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `865a0f28c2eab74ab73fac9464b3492c21d5f5a5a3184983a3ebf3542f5e5855`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] {f : α → ℝ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α),
  0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f → AEMeasurable f μ → ∫⁻ (ω : α), ENNReal.ofReal (f ω) ∂μ = ∫⁻ (t : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, μ {a | t ≤ f a}
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Nat.primeCounting'`: π(n - 1) We then prove that these are monotone in `Nat.monotone_primeCounting` and `Nat.monotone_primeCounting'`. The last main theorem `Nat.primeCounting'_add_le` is an upper bound on `π'` which arises by observing that all numbers greater than `k` and not coprime to `k` are not prime, and so only at most `φ(k)/k` fraction of the numbers from `k` to `n` are prime.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `58ece4ec9cb5fa727a704dea10490ab82dcf9135f9297dce3e52b614e1679a78`)


```lean
∀ {a k : ℕ}, a ≠ 0 → a < k → ∀ (n : ℕ), (k + n).primeCounting' ≤ k.primeCounting' + a.totient * (n / a + 1)
```

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`IsClosed.Icc_subset_of_forall_exists_gt`, `IsClosed.mem_of_ge_of_forall_exists_gt` : two other versions of the “continuous induction” principle.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `405ffef0e3f1eca4527cf69421ebb8bd7db162655acfba1bc53ea2ad37b4dc9a`)

```text
A "continuous induction principle" for a closed interval: if a set `s` meets `[a, b]`
on a closed subset, contains `a`, and for any `a ≤ x < y ≤ b`, `x ∈ s`, the set `s ∩ (x, y]`
is not empty, then `[a, b] ⊆ s`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `d9af027be6a72d947e1f08e611ead08695485bdc5103402632ba33f7cb689dbe`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u} [inst : ConditionallyCompleteLinearOrder α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace α] [OrderTopology α] {a b : α}
  {s : Set α},
  IsClosed (s ∩ Set.Icc a b) →
    a ∈ s → (∀ x ∈ s ∩ Set.Ico a b, ∀ y ∈ Set.Ioi x, (s ∩ Set.Ioc x y).Nonempty) → Set.Icc a b ⊆ s
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`WithSeminorms.banach_steinhaus`: the **Banach-Steinhaus** theorem, also called **Uniform Boundedness Principle**. Fix `E` a barrelled space and `F` a TVS satisfying `WithSeminorms q` for some `q`. Any family `𝓕 : ι → E →L[𝕜] F` of continuous linear maps that is pointwise bounded is (uniformly) equicontinuous. Here, pointwise bounded means that for all `k` and `x`, the family of real numbers `i ↦ q k (𝓕 i x)` is bounded above.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `efcbe325566a91983268b81e3ed67177c903942e3846626216c6616b44f461b6`)

```text
The **Banach-Steinhaus** theorem, or **Uniform Boundedness Principle**, for maps from a
barrelled space to any space whose topology is generated by a family of seminorms. Use
`WithSeminorms.equicontinuous_TFAE` and `Seminorm.bound_of_continuous` to get explicit bounds on
the seminorms from equicontinuity. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `67cd9467625310607b2951d567f1088f5a82f35db07e1835369dbc96b34aabe9`)

```lean
∀ {ι : Type u_2} {κ : Type u_3} {𝕜₁ : Type u_4} {𝕜₂ : Type u_5} {E : Type u_6} {F : Type u_7}
  [inst : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜₁] [inst_1 : NontriviallyNormedField 𝕜₂] {σ₁₂ : 𝕜₁ →+* 𝕜₂} [RingHomIsometric σ₁₂]
  [inst_3 : AddCommGroup E] [inst_4 : AddCommGroup F] [inst_5 : _root_.Module 𝕜₁ E] [inst_6 : _root_.Module 𝕜₂ F]
  [inst_7 : UniformSpace E] [inst_8 : UniformSpace F] [IsUniformAddGroup E] [IsUniformAddGroup F] [ContinuousSMul 𝕜₁ E]
  [BarrelledSpace 𝕜₁ E] {𝓕 : ι → E →SL[σ₁₂] F} {q : SeminormFamily 𝕜₂ F κ},
  WithSeminorms q →
    (∀ (k : κ) (x : E), BddAbove (Set.range fun i => (q k) ((𝓕 i) x))) → UniformEquicontinuous (DFunLike.coe ∘ 𝓕)
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Set.Finite.rado_selection`: A variant using `Set.Finite`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `b3fea63a9327ec659dbb109f0f4ac63aacd0c8f5398422d9be415bf5e569c59a`)

```text
Given a (dependent) function `g s : (a : α) → β a` for each finite set `s` of `α`, provided that
each `β a` is finite, we can find another function `χ : (a : α) → β a` such that on every `s`,
there is some larger `t` such that `χ` agrees with `g t` on `s`.
Informally, we are stitching together the local functions `g s` into a global `χ` such that on
each `s`, `χ` can be expressed in terms of one of the `g`.
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `5e27c6e19a0c4f67fe3d6148f4489db4c54dc8ae94d09ad107f4784f5ab07c45`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : α → Type u_2} [∀ (a : α), Finite (β a)] (g : (s : Set α) → s.Finite → (a : α) → β a),
  ∃ χ, ∀ (s : Set α), s.Finite → ∃ t, ∃ (ht : t.Finite), s ⊆ t ∧ ∀ x ∈ s, χ x = g t ht x
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`IsAlgClosure.of_splits`: if `K / k` is algebraic, and every monic irreducible polynomial over `k` splits in `K`, then `K` is algebraically closed (in fact an algebraic closure of `k`). For the stronger fact that only requires every such polynomial has a root in `K`, see `IsAlgClosure.of_exists_root`. Reference: <https://kconrad.math.uconn.edu/blurbs/galoistheory/algclosure.pdf>, Theorem 2
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `1a447c3d830d13fc0e63a096b8589787a3913265c46160cfff34ff48afb5cfef`)

Reference: <https://kconrad.math.uconn.edu/blurbs/galoistheory/algclosure.pdf>, Theorem 2

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

````text
`Submodule.LinearDisjoint.not_linearIndependent_pair_of_commute_of_flat`, `Submodule.LinearDisjoint.rank_inf_le_one_of_commute_of_flat`: if `M` and `N` are linearly disjoint, if one of `M` and `N` is flat, then any two commutative elements contained in the intersection of `M` and `N` are not `R`-linearly independent (namely, their span is not `R ^ 2`). In particular, if any two elements in the intersection of `M` and `N` are commutative, then the rank of the intersection of `M` and `N` is at most one. These results are stated using a bundled version (i.e. `a : ↥(M ⊓ N)`). If you want a non-bundled version (i.e. `a : S` with `ha : a ∈ M ⊓ N`), you may use `LinearIndependent.of_comp` and `FinVec.map_eq` (in `Mathlib/Data/Fin/Tuple/Reflection.lean`), see the following code snippet: ``` have h := H.not_linearIndependent_pair_of_commute_of_flat hf ⟨a, ha⟩ ⟨b, hb⟩ hc contrapose! h refine .of_comp (M ⊓ N).subtype ?_ convert h exact (FinVec.map_eq _ _).symm ```
````

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `6788a21cd57723b70fb31814a7b4c07a4723b9c96dfe22ec592f159ba8d5f138`)

```text
If the image of a family of vectors under a linear map is linearly independent, then so is
the original family. 
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`MeasureTheory.lintegral_eq_lintegral_meas_le` and `MeasureTheory.lintegral_eq_lintegral_meas_lt`: The most common special cases of the layer cake formulas, stating that for a nonnegative function f we have ∫ f(ω) ∂μ(ω) = ∫ μ {ω | f(ω) ≥ t} dt and ∫ f(ω) ∂μ(ω) = ∫ μ {ω | f(ω) > t} dt, respectively.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `9a1f5bc82b729a6632766c480a36a70f976ff6872f16b316e013d83d47e3f13d`)

```text
The standard case of the layer cake formula / Cavalieri's principle / tail probability formula:

For a nonnegative function `f` on a measure space, the Lebesgue integral of `f` can
be written (roughly speaking) as: `∫⁻ f ∂μ = ∫⁻ t in 0..∞, μ {ω | f(ω) > t}`.

See `lintegral_eq_lintegral_meas_le` for a version with sets of the form `{ω | f(ω) ≥ t}`
instead. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `6a147f95e1978254aed19010ae8e8a639d2d2a7682f43a8113269ad96bdd3c1a`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] {f : α → ℝ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α),
  0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f → AEMeasurable f μ → ∫⁻ (ω : α), ENNReal.ofReal (f ω) ∂μ = ∫⁻ (t : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, μ {a | t < f a}
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`IsPrimitiveRoot.norm_pow_sub_one_of_prime_pow_ne_two` : if `Irreducible (cyclotomic (p ^ (k + 1)) K)` (in particular for `K = ℚ`) and `p` is a prime, then the norm of `ζ ^ (p ^ s) - 1` is `p ^ (p ^ s)` `p ^ (k - s + 1) ≠ 2`. See the following lemmas for similar results. We also prove the analogous of this result for `zeta`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `0b15eee9d8f2bf084b1dc0bce4ae702378b4d7f16fefdc9523e41765cebcd875`)

```text
If `Irreducible (cyclotomic (p ^ (k + 1)) K)` (in particular for `K = ℚ`) and `p` is a prime,
then the norm of `ζ ^ (p ^ s) - 1` is `p ^ (p ^ s)` if `p ^ (k - s + 1) ≠ 2`. See the next lemmas
for similar results. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `1da2fb1b7b626c45152980aad70ec3c346b3ded0159806dd950376fc71961a09`)

```lean
∀ {p : ℕ} {K : Type u} {L : Type v} [inst : Field L] {ζ : L} [inst_1 : Field K] [inst_2 : Algebra K L] {k s : ℕ},
  IsPrimitiveRoot ζ (p ^ (k + 1)) →
    ∀ [hpri : Fact (Nat.Prime p)] [IsCyclotomicExtension {p ^ (k + 1)} K L],
      Irreducible (Polynomial.cyclotomic (p ^ (k + 1)) K) →
        s ≤ k → p ^ (k - s + 1) ≠ 2 → (Algebra.norm K) (ζ ^ p ^ s - 1) = ↑p ^ p ^ s
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`fg_of_fg_of_fg`: **Artin--Tate lemma**: if C/B/A is a tower of rings, and A is Noetherian, and C is algebra-finite over A, and C is module-finite over B, then B is algebra-finite over A.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `2220ca24c6160db5f5bb8d65489ccebf002bda95ac9b36daa106d82186dbc5dd`)

```text
**Artin--Tate lemma**: if A ⊆ B ⊆ C is a chain of subrings of commutative rings, and
A is Noetherian, and C is algebra-finite over A, and C is module-finite over B,
then B is algebra-finite over A.

References: Atiyah--Macdonald Proposition 7.8; Altman--Kleiman 16.17. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `6a7b32c58df080ad681067bd5c9e9f80a7689f5bc941429e66c2b90bc583f3c7`)

```lean
  [inst_3 : Algebra A B] [inst_4 : Algebra B C] [inst_5 : Algebra A C] [IsScalarTower A B C] [IsNoetherianRing A],
  ⊤.FG → ⊤.FG → Function.Injective ⇑(algebraMap B C) → ⊤.FG
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`LieAlgebra.InvariantForm.isSemisimple_of_nondegenerate`: the main result of this file; a finite-dimensional Lie algebra over a field is semisimple if it does not have non-trivial abelian ideals and admits a non-degenerate invariant reflexive bilinear form.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `78d54e1010c41366a97b741251b3cf9a8cbaa6d519fea6a2191426846f8475ad`)

```text
A finite-dimensional Lie algebra over a field is semisimple
if it does not have non-trivial abelian ideals and it admits a
non-degenerate reflexive invariant bilinear form.
Here a form is *invariant* if it is compatible with the Lie bracket: `Φ ⁅x, y⁆ z = Φ x ⁅y, z⁆`.
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `c5c88972a33b3915d82d8947982261deb13e0d400c35a5c25bedcdc686288249`)

```lean
∀ {K : Type u_1} {L : Type u_2} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : LieRing L] [inst_2 : LieAlgebra K L] [Module.Finite K L]
  (Φ : LinearMap.BilinForm K L),
  Φ.Nondegenerate →
    LinearMap.BilinForm.lieInvariant L Φ →
      Φ.IsRefl → (∀ (I : LieIdeal K L), IsAtom I → ¬IsLieAbelian ↥I) → LieAlgebra.IsSemisimple K L
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`MeasureTheory.lintegral_rpow_eq_lintegral_meas_le_mul` and `MeasureTheory.lintegral_rpow_eq_lintegral_meas_lt_mul`: other common special cases of the layer cake formulas, stating that for a nonnegative function `f` and `p > 0`, we have `∫ f(ω)ᵖ ∂μ(ω) = p * ∫ μ {ω | f(ω) ≥ t} * tᵖ⁻¹ dt` and `∫ f(ω)ᵖ ∂μ(ω) = p * ∫ μ {ω | f(ω) > t} * tᵖ⁻¹ dt`, respectively.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `28b5837423d66bd7368db8646ea556a28b930704029d2a5aa47666ef4595fac2`)

```text
An application of the layer cake formula / Cavalieri's principle / tail probability formula:

For a nonnegative function `f` on a measure space, the Lebesgue integral of `f` can
be written (roughly speaking) as: `∫⁻ f^p ∂μ = p * ∫⁻ t in 0..∞, t^(p-1) * μ {ω | f(ω) ≥ t}`.

See `MeasureTheory.lintegral_rpow_eq_lintegral_meas_lt_mul` for a version with sets of the form
`{ω | f(ω) > t}` instead. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `63cbaf4b7d858287ac8da02ca28382a5c96dbd7053684423d24616965a99e8ae`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) {f : α → ℝ},
  0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f →
    AEMeasurable f μ →
      ∀ {p : ℝ},
        0 < p →
          ∫⁻ (ω : α), ENNReal.ofReal (f ω ^ p) ∂μ =
            ENNReal.ofReal p * ∫⁻ (t : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, μ {a | t ≤ f a} * ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (p - 1))
```

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`IsAlgClosure.of_splits`: if `K / k` is algebraic, and every monic irreducible polynomial over `k` splits in `K`, then `K` is algebraically closed (in fact an algebraic closure of `k`). For the stronger fact that only requires every such polynomial has a root in `K`, see `IsAlgClosure.of_exists_root`. Reference: <https://kconrad.math.uconn.edu/blurbs/galoistheory/algclosure.pdf>, Theorem 2
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`MeasureTheory.lintegral_comp_eq_lintegral_meas_le_mul` and `MeasureTheory.lintegral_comp_eq_lintegral_meas_lt_mul`: The general layer cake formulas with Lebesgue integrals, written in terms of measures of sets of the forms {ω | t ≤ f(ω)} and {ω | t < f(ω)}, respectively.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `e359ac44c670022960bb9086216420815d02e332e69d4b3f487e8dbb7700dd8a`)

```text
The layer cake formula / **Cavalieri's principle** / tail probability formula:

Let `f` be a non-negative measurable function on a measure space. Let `G` be an
increasing absolutely continuous function on the positive real line, vanishing at the origin,
with derivative `G' = g`. Then the integral of the composition `G ∘ f` can be written as
the integral over the positive real line of the "tail measures" `μ {ω | f(ω) ≥ t}` of `f`
weighted by `g`.

Roughly speaking, the statement is: `∫⁻ (G ∘ f) ∂μ = ∫⁻ t in 0..∞, g(t) * μ {ω | f(ω) ≥ t}`.

See `MeasureTheory.lintegral_comp_eq_lintegral_meas_lt_mul` for a version with sets of the form
`{ω | f(ω) > t}` instead. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `e1499c394205aa6a9510eefdaedfaa4893d8a89533eddfb849f8314f42e22128`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] {f : α → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α),
  0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f →
    AEMeasurable f μ →
      (∀ t > 0, IntervalIntegrable g MeasureTheory.volume 0 t) →
        (∀ᵐ (t : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioi 0), 0 ≤ g t) →
          ∫⁻ (ω : α), ENNReal.ofReal (∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..f ω, g t) ∂μ =
            ∫⁻ (t : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, μ {a | t ≤ f a} * ENNReal.ofReal (g t)
```

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`IsCyclotomicExtension.Rat.Three.eq_one_or_neg_one_of_unit_of_congruent`: Given a unit `u : (𝓞 K)ˣ`, if `u` is congruent to an integer modulo `3`, then `u = 1` or `u = -1`. This is a special case of the so-called *Kummer's lemma* (see for example [washington_cyclotomic], Theorem 5.36).
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `fc6211a12483639172c188faa25088b73203500a56b87ca131433430c160ea77`)

```text
If a unit `u` is congruent to an integer modulo `λ ^ 2`, then `u = 1` or `u = -1`.

This is a special case of the so-called *Kummer's lemma*. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `aed47c51b7b3e55eae41d3bb184581525931098dc8476e989d2a200c6935adfe`)

```lean

  [inst_1 : NumberField K] [IsCyclotomicExtension {3} ℚ K], (∃ n, (hζ.toInteger - 1) ^ 2 ∣ ↑u - ↑n) → u = 1 ∨ u = -1
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`MeasureTheory.lintegral_rpow_eq_lintegral_meas_le_mul` and `MeasureTheory.lintegral_rpow_eq_lintegral_meas_lt_mul`: other common special cases of the layer cake formulas, stating that for a nonnegative function `f` and `p > 0`, we have `∫ f(ω)ᵖ ∂μ(ω) = p * ∫ μ {ω | f(ω) ≥ t} * tᵖ⁻¹ dt` and `∫ f(ω)ᵖ ∂μ(ω) = p * ∫ μ {ω | f(ω) > t} * tᵖ⁻¹ dt`, respectively.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `e55d1ba233d46f5328a4eca333848858468f945fb1cf44ef2cdb55cdcd30f96d`)

```text
An application of the layer cake formula / Cavalieri's principle / tail probability formula:

For a nonnegative function `f` on a measure space, the Lebesgue integral of `f` can
be written (roughly speaking) as: `∫⁻ f^p ∂μ = p * ∫⁻ t in 0..∞, t^(p-1) * μ {ω | f(ω) > t}`.

See `MeasureTheory.lintegral_rpow_eq_lintegral_meas_le_mul` for a version with sets of the form
`{ω | f(ω) ≥ t}` instead. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `6d66a669575e544248296033a220e6922de5385073a3d61aaa5769ab98e7a106`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) {f : α → ℝ},
  0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f →
    AEMeasurable f μ →
      ∀ {p : ℝ},
        0 < p →
          ∫⁻ (ω : α), ENNReal.ofReal (f ω ^ p) ∂μ =
            ENNReal.ofReal p * ∫⁻ (t : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, μ {a | t < f a} * ENNReal.ofReal (t ^ (p - 1))
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`MeasureTheory.lintegral_comp_eq_lintegral_meas_le_mul` and `MeasureTheory.lintegral_comp_eq_lintegral_meas_lt_mul`: The general layer cake formulas with Lebesgue integrals, written in terms of measures of sets of the forms {ω | t ≤ f(ω)} and {ω | t < f(ω)}, respectively.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `00e267d6c25d2df2ee0ca12c197a34bf3795acd06f04294c738a509e6ada27b8`)

```text
The layer cake formula / Cavalieri's principle / tail probability formula:

Let `f` be a non-negative measurable function on a measure space. Let `G` be an
increasing absolutely continuous function on the positive real line, vanishing at the origin,
with derivative `G' = g`. Then the integral of the composition `G ∘ f` can be written as
the integral over the positive real line of the "tail measures" `μ {ω | f(ω) > t}` of `f`
weighted by `g`.

Roughly speaking, the statement is: `∫⁻ (G ∘ f) ∂μ = ∫⁻ t in 0..∞, g(t) * μ {ω | f(ω) > t}`.

See `lintegral_comp_eq_lintegral_meas_le_mul` for a version with sets of the form `{ω | f(ω) ≥ t}`
instead. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `da9183b01556d8551ef4c48b6a850cc590ed0d604484a75692c00cc7600b106f`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace α] {f : α → ℝ} {g : ℝ → ℝ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α),
  0 ≤ᵐ[μ] f →
    AEMeasurable f μ →
      (∀ t > 0, IntervalIntegrable g MeasureTheory.volume 0 t) →
        (∀ᵐ (t : ℝ) ∂MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Set.Ioi 0), 0 ≤ g t) →
          ∫⁻ (ω : α), ENNReal.ofReal (∫ (t : ℝ) in 0..f ω, g t) ∂μ =
            ∫⁻ (t : ℝ) in Set.Ioi 0, μ {a | t < f a} * ENNReal.ofReal (g t)
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`MeasureTheory.maximal_ineq`: Doob's maximal inequality.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `342a0c14d59155cd51bc45e34d316d28586e1b86858d41254b365c25bdf1c4e2`)

```text
**Doob's maximal inequality**: Given a non-negative submartingale `f`, for all `ε : ℝ≥0`,
we have `ε • μ {ε ≤ f* n} ≤ ∫ ω in {ε ≤ f* n}, f n` where `f* n ω = max_{k ≤ n}, f k ω`.

In some literature, the Doob's maximal inequality refers to what we call Doob's Lp inequality
(which is a corollary of this lemma and will be proved in an upcoming PR). 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `7beeaf89f83f832738f99bf2ae77eb3a28e0f59aff5449f0b40a2f13714afc92`)

```lean
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {𝒢 : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0}
  {f : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ],
  MeasureTheory.Submartingale f 𝒢 μ →
    0 ≤ f →
      ∀ {ε : NNReal} (n : ℕ),
        ↑ε * μ {ω | ↑ε ≤ (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' ⋯ fun k => f k ω} ≤
          ENNReal.ofReal (∫ (ω : Ω) in {ω | ↑ε ≤ (Finset.range (n + 1)).sup' ⋯ fun k => f k ω}, f n ω ∂μ)
```


### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`ProbabilityTheory.measure_limsup_eq_one`: the second Borel-Cantelli lemma. **Note**: for the *first Borel-Cantelli lemma*, which holds in general measure spaces (not only in probability spaces), see `MeasureTheory.measure_limsup_atTop_eq_zero`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `72c40c437d635016e6d26092c210574fcb130ac51b6391963d8f4f07ae963eaf`)

```text
One direction of the **Borel-Cantelli lemma**
(sometimes called the "*first* Borel-Cantelli lemma"):
if `(s i)` is a sequence of sets such that `∑' i, μ (s i)` is finite,
then the limit superior of the `s i` along the `atTop` filter is a null set.

Note: for the *second* Borel-Cantelli lemma (applying to independent sets in a probability space),
see `ProbabilityTheory.measure_limsup_eq_one`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `6107880b92e0950640599009d22923d5666d7fe32f72de2955b271501177102c`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} {F : Type u_3} [inst : FunLike F (Set α) ENNReal] [MeasureTheory.OuterMeasureClass F α] {μ : F}
  {s : ℕ → Set α}, ∑' (i : ℕ), μ (s i) ≠ ⊤ → μ (Filter.limsup s Filter.atTop) = 0
```

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`PowerSeries.IsWeierstrassFactorization.elim`, `PowerSeries.IsWeierstrassFactorization.unique`: `f` and `h` in Weierstrass preparation theorem are unique.
```

```text
The `f` and `h` in the Weierstrass preparation theorem are unique.

This result is stated using two `PowerSeries.IsWeierstrassFactorization` assertions, and only
requires the ring being Hausdorff with respect to the maximal ideal. If you want `f` and `h` equal
to `PowerSeries.weierstrassDistinguished` and `PowerSeries.weierstrassUnit`,
use `PowerSeries.IsWeierstrassFactorization.unique` instead, which requires the ring being
complete with respect to the maximal ideal. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `e2b09afdca0ff9593f00056f285048e617bf29931cf0c4937f28fd594656b18a`)

```lean
∀ {A : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing A] [inst_1 : IsLocalRing A] [IsHausdorff (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A]
  {g : PowerSeries A} {f f' : Polynomial A} {h h' : PowerSeries A},
  g.IsWeierstrassFactorization f h → g.IsWeierstrassFactorization f' h' → f = f' ∧ h = h'
```

```text
Suppose
* F is a `Type u`-valued sheaf on `Sch` with respect to the Zariski topology
* X : ι → Sch is a family of schemes
* f : Π i, yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ F is a family of relatively representable open immersions
* f is jointly surjective

Then `F` is representable.
```

```lean
  {X : ι → AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} {f : (i : ι) → CategoryTheory.yoneda.obj (X i) ⟶ F.obj},
  (∀ (i : ι), AlgebraicGeometry.IsOpenImmersion.presheaf (f i)) →
    ∀
      [CategoryTheory.Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.zariskiTopology
          (CategoryTheory.Limits.Sigma.desc f)],
      F.obj.IsRepresentable
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Complex.hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_of_differentiable_off_countable`: If `f : ℂ → E` is continuous on a closed disc of positive radius and is complex differentiable on the corresponding open disc, then it is analytic on the corresponding open disc, and the coefficients of the power series are given by Cauchy integral formulas.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `6478609a444febe01243a7d1002acb230af00fbdf37c42fb0a5a5b43b41c74eb`)

```text
If `f : ℂ → E` is continuous on a closed ball of positive radius and is differentiable at all
but countably many points of the corresponding open ball, then it is analytic on the open ball with
coefficients of the power series given by Cauchy integral formulas. 
```

```lean
  {f : ℂ → E} {s : Set ℂ},
  s.Countable →
    ContinuousOn f (Metric.closedBall c ↑R) →
      (∀ z ∈ Metric.ball c ↑R \ s, DifferentiableAt ℂ f z) →
        0 < R → HasFPowerSeriesOnBall f (cauchyPowerSeries f c ↑R) c ↑R
```

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`IntermediateField.sepDegree_adjoin_eq_of_isAlgebraic_of_isPurelyInseparable`, `IntermediateField.sepDegree_adjoin_eq_of_isAlgebraic_of_isPurelyInseparable'`: if `K / E / F` is a field extension tower, such that `E / F` is purely inseparable, then for any subset `S` of `K` such that `F(S) / F` is algebraic, the `E(S) / E` and `F(S) / F` have the same separable degree. In particular, if `S` is an intermediate field of `K / F` such that `S / F` is algebraic, the `E(S) / E` and `S / F` have the same separable degree.
```

```text
the same separable degree.
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`ProbabilityTheory.measure_ge_le_exp_cgf` and `ProbabilityTheory.measure_le_le_exp_cgf`: Chernoff bound on the upper (resp. lower) tail of a random variable. For `t` nonnegative such that the cumulant-generating function exists, `ℙ(ε ≤ X) ≤ exp(- t*ε + cgf X ℙ t)`. See also `ProbabilityTheory.measure_ge_le_exp_mul_mgf` and `ProbabilityTheory.measure_le_le_exp_mul_mgf` for versions of these results using `mgf` instead of `cgf`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `c372058ccadfd8582e627e71f68500ab164d5eb47abbd3d85b8201b2d777a6d6`)

```text
**Chernoff bound** on the upper tail of a real random variable. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `11933a0b04bf8d3335f0791c3b24f7d77cd26dd90e6a72a1005fc25d8d615558`)

```lean
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {t : ℝ}
  [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] (ε : ℝ),
  0 ≤ t →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ →
      μ.real {ω | ε ≤ X ω} ≤ Real.exp (-t * ε + ProbabilityTheory.cgf X μ t)
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`hahnEmbedding_isOrderedModule`: there exists a strictly monotone `M →ₗ[K] Lex R⟦FiniteArchimedeanClass M⟧` that maps `ArchimedeanClass M` to `HahnSeries.orderTop` in the expected way, as long as `HahnEmbedding.Seed K M R` is nonempty.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `3fdd71faaa253ce0f2470b490ae7a7cc9966cd8d7c4ee9a22c176cd56e276ecd`)

```text
**Hahn embedding theorem for an ordered module**

There exists a strictly monotone `M →ₗ[K] Lex R⟦FiniteArchimedeanClass M⟧` that maps
`ArchimedeanClass M` to `HahnSeries.orderTop` in the expected way, as long as
`HahnEmbedding.Seed K M R` is nonempty. The `HahnEmbedding.Partial` with maximal domain is the
desired embedding. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `ff1d0337ae92d67f95a598075b374a1902de6c3105d43501ef72fb6d72760e5f`)

```lean
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : DivisionRing K] [inst_1 : LinearOrder K] [inst_2 : IsOrderedRing K] [inst_3 : Archimedean K]
  {M : Type u_2} [inst_4 : AddCommGroup M] [inst_5 : LinearOrder M] [inst_6 : IsOrderedAddMonoid M]
  [inst_7 : _root_.Module K M] [inst_8 : IsOrderedModule K M] {R : Type u_3} [inst_9 : AddCommGroup R]
  [inst_10 : LinearOrder R] [inst_11 : _root_.Module K R] [IsOrderedAddMonoid R] [Archimedean R]
  [h : Nonempty (HahnEmbedding.Seed K M R)],
  ∃ f,
    StrictMono ⇑f ∧ ∀ (a : M), ArchimedeanClass.mk a = (FiniteArchimedeanClass.withTopOrderIso M) (ofLex (f a)).orderTop
```

```text

power-multiplicative nonarchimedean `K`-algebra norm on `L` extending the norm on `K`. 
```

```lean
    IsNonarchimedean norm → ∃ f, IsPowMul ⇑f ∧ (∀ (x : K), f ((algebraMap K L) x) = ‖x‖) ∧ IsNonarchimedean ⇑f
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`IntermediateField.sepDegree_adjoin_eq_of_isAlgebraic_of_isPurelyInseparable`, `IntermediateField.sepDegree_adjoin_eq_of_isAlgebraic_of_isPurelyInseparable'`: if `K / E / F` is a field extension tower, such that `E / F` is purely inseparable, then for any subset `S` of `K` such that `F(S) / F` is algebraic, the `E(S) / E` and `F(S) / F` have the same separable degree. In particular, if `S` is an intermediate field of `K / F` such that `S / F` is algebraic, the `E(S) / E` and `S / F` have the same separable degree.
```

```text
for any intermediate field `S` of `K / F` such that `S / F` is algebraic, the `E(S) / E` and
`S / F` have the same separable degree. 
```

```lean
  [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F ↥S] [IsPurelyInseparable F E],
  Field.sepDegree E ↥(IntermediateField.adjoin E ↑S) = Field.sepDegree F ↥S
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`ProbabilityTheory.measure_ge_le_exp_cgf` and `ProbabilityTheory.measure_le_le_exp_cgf`: Chernoff bound on the upper (resp. lower) tail of a random variable. For `t` nonnegative such that the cumulant-generating function exists, `ℙ(ε ≤ X) ≤ exp(- t*ε + cgf X ℙ t)`. See also `ProbabilityTheory.measure_ge_le_exp_mul_mgf` and `ProbabilityTheory.measure_le_le_exp_mul_mgf` for versions of these results using `mgf` instead of `cgf`.
```

```text
**Chernoff bound** on the upper tail of a real random variable. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `ae23822ea7bd4f6683083d4cec6c78e0053f6703c72cb527218c07c02877ca11`)

```lean
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {t : ℝ}
  [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] (ε : ℝ),
  0 ≤ t →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ →
      μ.real {ω | ε ≤ X ω} ≤ Real.exp (-t * ε) * ProbabilityTheory.mgf X μ t
```

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Polynomial.C_leadingCoeff_mul_prod_multiset_X_sub_C`: If a polynomial has as many roots as its degree, it can be written as the product of its leading coefficient with `∏ (X - a)` where `a` ranges through its roots.

```

```lean
  p.roots.card = p.natDegree →
    Polynomial.C p.leadingCoeff * (Multiset.map (fun a => Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) p.roots).prod = p
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`ProbabilityTheory.measure_ge_le_exp_cgf` and `ProbabilityTheory.measure_le_le_exp_cgf`: Chernoff bound on the upper (resp. lower) tail of a random variable. For `t` nonnegative such that the cumulant-generating function exists, `ℙ(ε ≤ X) ≤ exp(- t*ε + cgf X ℙ t)`. See also `ProbabilityTheory.measure_ge_le_exp_mul_mgf` and `ProbabilityTheory.measure_le_le_exp_mul_mgf` for versions of these results using `mgf` instead of `cgf`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `b46e3f20d50c73e8a2f3dcf374aade6b37bf9b29f1d63480fe8be78dd861a663`)

```text
**Chernoff bound** on the lower tail of a real random variable. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `ade77bd3bbcd978a1114f37f90b0231a2ee417e34a97da9025bbac807204b6ab`)

```lean
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {t : ℝ}
  [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] (ε : ℝ),
  t ≤ 0 →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ →
      μ.real {ω | X ω ≤ ε} ≤ Real.exp (-t * ε + ProbabilityTheory.cgf X μ t)
```

```text
analytic on the corresponding open disc, and the coefficients of the power series are given by
Cauchy integral formulas. See also
`Complex.hasFPowerSeriesOnBall_of_differentiable_off_countable` for a version of this lemma with
weaker assumptions.
```


#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `88caf66b0ee38ad172e762710ff5b3cf36b83d9932768869d8bd0acd04dcb443`)

```text
If `M` and `N` are linearly disjoint, `M'` and `N'` are submodules of `M` and `N`,

```

```lean
  M.LinearDisjoint N →
    ∀ {M' N' : Submodule R S}, M' ≤ M → N' ≤ N → ∀ [Module.Flat R ↥M] [Module.Flat R ↥N'], M'.LinearDisjoint N'
```

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`ProbabilityTheory.measure_ge_le_exp_cgf` and `ProbabilityTheory.measure_le_le_exp_cgf`: Chernoff bound on the upper (resp. lower) tail of a random variable. For `t` nonnegative such that the cumulant-generating function exists, `ℙ(ε ≤ X) ≤ exp(- t*ε + cgf X ℙ t)`. ```lean
```
```lean
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {t : ℝ}
  [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] (ε : ℝ),
  t ≤ 0 →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ →
      μ.real {ω | X ω ≤ ε} ≤ Real.exp (-t * ε) * ProbabilityTheory.mgf X μ t
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`UniformOnFun.comap_eq`: if `u` is a uniform structures on `β` and `f : γ → β`, then `𝒱(α, γ, 𝔖, comap f u) = comap (fun g ↦ f ∘ g) 𝒱(α, γ, 𝔖, u₁)`. An interesting note about these statements is that they are proved without ever unfolding the basis definition of the uniform structure of uniform convergence! Instead, we build a (not very interesting) Galois connection `UniformFun.gc` and then rely on the Galois connection API to do most of the work.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `5c7a77674ff3cb70240eaa013ce801a6801627a5268cbb2470c97b47f00dca8b`)

```text
The function `UniformFun.filter α β : Filter (β × β) → Filter ((α →ᵤ β) × (α →ᵤ β))`
has a lower adjoint `l` (in the sense of `GaloisConnection`). The exact definition of `l` is not
interesting; we will only use that it exists (in `UniformFun.mono` and
`UniformFun.iInf_eq`) and that
`l (Filter.map (Prod.map f f) 𝓕) = Filter.map (Prod.map ((∘) f) ((∘) f)) (l 𝓕)` for each
`𝓕 : Filter (γ × γ)` and `f : γ → α` (in `UniformFun.comap_eq`). 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `c2a24711550c07eec90df79a81a6a436ffa81dd76ee0c0d3e41ff81f56792075`)

```lean
∀ (α : Type u_1) (β : Type u_2),
  GaloisConnection (fun 𝓐 => Filter.map (UniformFun.phi α β) (𝓐 ×ˢ ⊤)) fun 𝓕 => UniformFun.filter α β 𝓕
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`GenContFract.compExactValue_correctness_of_stream_eq_some` shows that `GenContFract.compExactValue` indeed returns the value `v` when given the convergent and fractional part as described in the summary.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `072f9dbd61baf6805d8132817a9cc0aada639ba803439c5165b2a9f42d3a271f`)

```text
Shows the correctness of `compExactValue` in case the continued fraction
`GenContFract.of v` did not terminate at position `n`. That is, we obtain the
value `v` if we pass the two successive (auxiliary) continuants at positions `n` and `n + 1` as well
as the fractional part at `IntFractPair.stream n` to `compExactValue`.

The correctness might be seen more readily if one uses `convs'` to evaluate the continued
fraction. Here is an example to illustrate the idea:

Let `(v : ℚ) := 3.4`. We have
- `GenContFract.IntFractPair.stream v 0 = some ⟨3, 0.4⟩`, and
- `GenContFract.IntFractPair.stream v 1 = some ⟨2, 0.5⟩`.

Now `(GenContFract.of v).convs' 1 = 3 + 1/2`, and our fractional term at position `2` is `0.5`.
We hence have `v = 3 + 1/(2 + 0.5) = 3 + 1/2.5 = 3.4`.
This computation corresponds exactly to the one using the recurrence equation in `compExactValue`.
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `b072d98b03c86ee18d7b2468994bb0d296e009deebcf368b3d9fb7af13dc4dcc`)

```lean
∀ {K : Type u_1} [inst : Field K] [inst_1 : LinearOrder K] {v : K} {n : ℕ} [inst_2 : FloorRing K]
  {ifp_n : GenContFract.IntFractPair K},
  GenContFract.IntFractPair.stream v n = some ifp_n →
    v = GenContFract.compExactValue ((GenContFract.of v).contsAux n) ((GenContFract.of v).contsAux (n + 1)) ifp_n.fr
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`MeasureTheory.integral_Ioi_of_hasDerivAt_of_tendsto` is a version of FTC-2 on the interval `(a, +∞)`, giving the formula `∫ x in (a, +∞), g' x = l - g a` if `g'` is integrable and `g` tends to `l` at `+∞`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `72d823ef2e35782435da0a92a7806896326e3c56da013dc47b903f578b72cbd2`)

```text
**Fundamental theorem of calculus-2**, on semi-infinite intervals `(a, +∞)`.
When a function has a limit at infinity `m`, and its derivative is integrable, then the
integral of the derivative on `(a, +∞)` is `m - f a`. Version assuming differentiability
on `(a, +∞)` and continuity at `a⁺`.

Note that such a function always has a limit at infinity,
see `tendsto_limUnder_of_hasDerivAt_of_integrableOn_Ioi`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `b2ac155c53207bf7c8db92837e373c8db294f4e7521a8e3ca2423f23c8ae2106`)

```lean
∀ {E : Type u_1} {f f' : ℝ → E} {a : ℝ} {m : E} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℝ E]
  [CompleteSpace E],
  ContinuousWithinAt f (Set.Ici a) a →
    (∀ x ∈ Set.Ioi a, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) →
      MeasureTheory.IntegrableOn f' (Set.Ioi a) MeasureTheory.volume →
        Filter.Tendsto f Filter.atTop (nhds m) → ∫ (x : ℝ) in Set.Ioi a, f' x = m - f a
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`MeasureTheory.ae_mem_limsup_atTop_iff`: Lévy's generalized Borel-Cantelli: given a filtration `ℱ` and a sequence of sets `s` such that `s n ∈ ℱ n` for all `n`, `limsup atTop s` is almost everywhere equal to the set for which `∑ ℙ[s (n + 1)∣ℱ n] = ∞`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `fe338c90d915a65f2dc9a1a222fc040874d665e7e6dfee57bfdca2f5f83a368c`)

```text
**Lévy's generalization of the Borel-Cantelli lemma**: given a sequence of sets `s` and a
filtration `ℱ` such that for all `n`, `s n` is `ℱ n`-measurable, `limsup s atTop` is almost
everywhere equal to the set for which `∑ k, ℙ(s (k + 1) | ℱ k) = ∞`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `a535fd419dbb5fa0d27bdb8a5d6aabf5ef9a9eaa55cf1c7ff8f15d858a379f9e`)

```lean
∀ {Ω : Type u_2} {m0 : MeasurableSpace Ω} {ℱ : MeasureTheory.Filtration ℕ m0} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [MeasureTheory.IsFiniteMeasure μ] {s : ℕ → Set Ω},
  (∀ (n : ℕ), MeasurableSet (s n)) →
    ∀ᵐ (ω : Ω) ∂μ,
      ω ∈ Filter.limsup s Filter.atTop ↔
        Filter.Tendsto (fun n => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, μ[(s (k + 1)).indicator 1 | ↑ℱ k] ω) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`UniformOnFun.comap_eq`: if `u` is a uniform structures on `β` and `f : γ → β`, then `𝒱(α, γ, 𝔖, comap f u) = comap (fun g ↦ f ∘ g) 𝒱(α, γ, 𝔖, u₁)`. An interesting note about these statements is that they are proved without ever unfolding the basis definition of the uniform structure of uniform convergence! Instead, we build a (not very interesting) Galois connection `UniformFun.gc` and then rely on the Galois connection API to do most of the work.
```


```text
`{ u_i }`, `{ v_j }` of `A`, `B`, the products `{ u_i * v_j }`
are linearly independent over `F`. 
```

```lean
      LinearIndependent F a → LinearIndependent F b → LinearIndependent F fun i => ↑(a i.1) * ↑(b i.2)
```

```text
`MeasureTheory.tendstoInMeasure_iff_tendsto_Lp_finite`: Vitali convergence theorem: a sequence of Lp functions converges in Lp if and only if it is uniformly integrable and converges in measure.

```

```lean
  1 ≤ p →

      (∀ (n : ℕ), MeasureTheory.MemLp (f n) p μ) →
        MeasureTheory.MemLp g p μ →
          (MeasureTheory.TendstoInMeasure μ f Filter.atTop g ∧ MeasureTheory.UnifIntegrable f p μ ↔

```

```text
then for almost every `ω`, `f n ω` is bounded above (in `n`) if and only if it converges.
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`RestrictedProduct.continuous_dom_prod_left`: assume that each `A i` is an **open** subset of `R i`. Then, for any topological space `Y`, a map from `Y × Πʳ i, [R i, A i]` is continuous *if and only if* its restriction to each `Y × Πʳ i, [R i, A i]_[𝓟 S]` (with `S` cofinite) is continuous.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `82609cf44591d82b8c307ecb5b849bcac29c7aa6f485ef796c6406c3dc39a465`)

```text
The **universal property with parameters** of the topology on the restricted product:
for any topological space `Y` of "parameters", a map from `Y × Πʳ i, [R i, A i]` is continuous
*iff* its restriction to each `Y × Πʳ i, [R i, A i]_[𝓟 S]` (with `S` cofinite) is continuous. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `70d1fc63674e64d952cd61e9186a71bc29b18eee9ebaf2faa2da61b221a5b0cf`)

```lean
∀ {ι : Type u_1} {R : ι → Type u_2} {A : (i : ι) → Set (R i)} [inst : (i : ι) → TopologicalSpace (R i)],
  (∀ (i : ι), IsOpen (A i)) →
    ∀ {X : Type u_3} {Y : Type u_4} [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace X] [inst_2 : TopologicalSpace Y]
      {f : Y × RestrictedProduct (fun i => R i) (fun i => A i) Filter.cofinite → X},
      Continuous f ↔
        ∀ (S : Set ι) (hS : Filter.cofinite ≤ Filter.principal S),
          Continuous (f ∘ Prod.map id (RestrictedProduct.inclusion R A hS))
```

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`IntermediateField.LinearDisjoint.isField_of_isAlgebraic`, `IntermediateField.LinearDisjoint.isField_of_isAlgebraic'`: if `A` and `B` are field extensions of `F`, one of them is algebraic, such that they are linearly disjoint (more generally, if there exists a field extension of `F` that they embed into with linearly disjoint images), then `A ⊗[F] B` is a field.
```

```text
If `A` and `L` are linearly disjoint over `F` and one of them is algebraic,
then `A ⊗[F] L` is a field. 
```

```lean
∀ {F : Type u} {E : Type v} [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Field E] [inst_2 : Algebra F E] {A : IntermediateField F E}
  {L : Type w} [inst_3 : Field L] [inst_4 : Algebra F L] [inst_5 : Algebra L E] [inst_6 : IsScalarTower F L E],
  A.LinearDisjoint L → Algebra.IsAlgebraic F ↥A ∨ Algebra.IsAlgebraic F L → IsField (TensorProduct F (↥A) L)
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`MeasureTheory.SignedMeasure.singularPart_add_withDensity_rnDeriv_eq` : the Lebesgue decomposition theorem between a signed measure and a σ-finite positive measure.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `bc28ac352e32538c2f722f8f445cb5cb94d8097ae7a978319f09d47703061e66`)

```text
**The Lebesgue Decomposition theorem between a signed measure and a measure**:
Given a signed measure `s` and a σ-finite measure `μ`, there exist a signed measure `t` and a
measurable and integrable function `f`, such that `t` is mutually singular with respect to `μ`
and `s = t + μ.withDensityᵥ f`. In this case `t = s.singularPart μ` and
`f = s.rnDeriv μ`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `2dbde640575d3dc407cb17c951f1a019a2aa960a2e38e5cecda63c9409f5f642`)

```lean
∀ {α : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace α} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α) (s : MeasureTheory.SignedMeasure α)
  [s.HaveLebesgueDecomposition μ], s.singularPart μ + μ.withDensityᵥ (s.rnDeriv μ) = s
```

```text
`(λ s)⁻¹ * ∫ x in s, x ∂λ` where `λ` is the Lebesgue measure. 
```



```text

field `E` that `A` and `B` embeds into with linearly disjoint images, then `A ⊗[F] B`
is a field. 
```

```lean
  fa.fieldRange.LinearDisjoint ↥fb.fieldRange →
    Algebra.IsAlgebraic F A ∨ Algebra.IsAlgebraic F B → IsField (TensorProduct F A B)
```

```text
`Submodule.natAbs_det_basis_change`: let `b` be a `ℤ`-basis for a module `M` over `ℤ` and let `bN` be a basis for a submodule `N` of the same dimension. Then the cardinal of `M ⧸ N` is given by taking the determinant of `bN` over `b`.
```

```text
Let `b` be a basis for `M` over `ℤ` and `bN` a basis for `N` over `ℤ` of the same dimension.
Then an alternative way to compute the cardinality of `M ⧸ N` is given by taking the determinant
of `bN` over `b`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `ac3988f910e46c9b7c8c6d285860baa2750b34fedc10337de6ba14e55aedf4a6`)

```lean
  [inst_4 : DecidableEq ι] (b : Module.Basis ι ℤ M) (N : Submodule ℤ M) (bN : Module.Basis ι ℤ ↥N),
  (b.det (Subtype.val ∘ ⇑bN)).natAbs = Nat.card (M ⧸ N)
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`PhragmenLindelof.right_half_plane_of_tendsto_zero_on_real`, `PhragmenLindelof.right_half_plane_of_bounded_on_real`: two versions of the Phragmen-Lindelöf principle in the right half-plane;
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `c83414d55f10dd1841891d188981cf899589b700b23ff8e31554c1cf78711d08`)

```text
**Phragmen-Lindelöf principle** in the right half-plane. Let `f : ℂ → E` be a function such that

* `f` is differentiable in the open right half-plane and is continuous on its closure;
* `‖f z‖` is bounded from above by `A * exp(B * ‖z‖ ^ c)` on the open right half-plane
  for some `c < 2`;
* `‖f z‖` is bounded from above by a constant `C` on the imaginary axis;
* `‖f x‖` is bounded from above by a constant for large real values of `x`.

Then `‖f z‖` is bounded from above by `C` on the closed right half-plane.
See also `PhragmenLindelof.right_half_plane_of_tendsto_zero_on_real` for a weaker version. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `d9026cf726b9514b662a86fdd5abf5a909048569e9a2e233b83d51ed184944c3`)

```lean
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℂ E] {C : ℝ} {f : ℂ → E} {z : ℂ},
  DiffContOnCl ℂ f {z | 0 < z.re} →
    (∃ c < 2, ∃ B, f =O[Bornology.cobounded ℂ ⊓ Filter.principal {z | 0 < z.re}] fun z => Real.exp (B * ‖z‖ ^ c)) →
      (Filter.IsBoundedUnder (fun x1 x2 => x1 ≤ x2) Filter.atTop fun x => ‖f ↑x‖) →
        (∀ (x : ℝ), ‖f (↑x * Complex.I)‖ ≤ C) → 0 ≤ z.re → ‖f z‖ ≤ C
```

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`IsPurelyInseparable.of_injective_comp_algebraMap`: if `L` is an algebraically closed field containing `E`, such that the map `(E →+* L) → (F →+* L)` induced by `algebraMap F E` is injective, then `E / F` is purely inseparable. purely inseparable. As a corollary, epimorphisms in the category of fields must be
```
```text
purely inseparable extensions. 
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Matrix.isIrreducible_iff_exists_pow_pos`: Shows the equivalence between the graph-theoretic definition of irreducibility (strong connectivity) and the algebraic one (existence of a positive entry in some power).
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `d932157cfc86a536f5993b299e3bd7ad6d5022ef035d1f71ecce0627b43bda5c`)

```text
Irreducibility of a nonnegative matrix `A` is equivalent to entrywise positivity of some
power: between any two indices `i, j` there exists a positive integer `k` such that the
`(i, j)`-entry of `A ^ k` is strictly positive. 
```

```lean
  [IsOrderedRing R] [PosMulStrictMono R] [Nontrivial R] [inst_6 : DecidableEq n],
  (∀ (i j : n), 0 ≤ A i j) → (A.IsIrreducible ↔ ∀ (i j : n), ∃ k > 0, 0 < (A ^ k) i j)
```


```lean
    PowerSeries.mk fun p => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, ↑k ^ p * (algebraMap ℚ A) (↑p.factorial)⁻¹
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`HolderWith.dimH_image_le` etc: if `f : X → Y` is Hölder continuous with exponent `r > 0`, then for any `s`, `dimH (f '' s) ≤ dimH s / r`. We prove versions of this statement for `HolderWith`, `HolderOnWith`, and locally Hölder maps, as well as for `Set.image` and `Set.range`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `ae95bc5c84c46faac277afa2b5c18aa28c8057487988697b7c20b38c22658ccf`)

```text
If `f : X → Y` is Hölder continuous with a positive exponent `r`, then the Hausdorff dimension
of the image of a set `s` is at most `dimH s / r`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `d6da53a42a2ccd0c32682d7522772b7d14430ab5ab5207f8d762ee01f40b9b8b`)

```lean
∀ {X : Type u_2} {Y : Type u_3} [inst : EMetricSpace X] [inst_1 : EMetricSpace Y] {C r : NNReal} {f : X → Y},
  HolderWith C r f → 0 < r → ∀ (s : Set X), dimH (f '' s) ≤ dimH s / ↑r
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`PhragmenLindelof.right_half_plane_of_tendsto_zero_on_real`, `PhragmenLindelof.right_half_plane_of_bounded_on_real`: two versions of the Phragmen-Lindelöf principle in the right half-plane;
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `5ea729d73c06dc778445aeedebe26319e1adf469df0085bc000cfa34a6ab3556`)

```text
**Phragmen-Lindelöf principle** in the right half-plane. Let `f : ℂ → E` be a function such that

* `f` is differentiable in the open right half-plane and is continuous on its closure;
* `‖f z‖` is bounded from above by `A * exp(B * ‖z‖ ^ c)` on the open right half-plane
  for some `c < 2`;
* `‖f z‖` is bounded from above by a constant `C` on the imaginary axis;
* `f x → 0` as `x : ℝ` tends to infinity.

Then `‖f z‖` is bounded from above by the same constant on the closed right half-plane.
See also `PhragmenLindelof.right_half_plane_of_bounded_on_real` for a stronger version. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `ef67d31afa58e4903c3d776300953e114ca9e318a30e455fb6261bc07d2f1de9`)

```lean
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℂ E] {C : ℝ} {f : ℂ → E} {z : ℂ},
  DiffContOnCl ℂ f {z | 0 < z.re} →
    (∃ c < 2, ∃ B, f =O[Bornology.cobounded ℂ ⊓ Filter.principal {z | 0 < z.re}] fun z => Real.exp (B * ‖z‖ ^ c)) →
      Filter.Tendsto (fun x => f ↑x) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) →
        (∀ (x : ℝ), ‖f (↑x * Complex.I)‖ ≤ C) → 0 ≤ z.re → ‖f z‖ ≤ C
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Matrix.pow_apply_pos_iff_nonempty_path`: Establishes the link between matrix powers and graph theory: `(A ^ k) i j > 0` if and only if there is a path of length `k` from `i` to `j` in `toQuiver A`.
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `d45af37159a59ad7cfa7c89402ad57dc423a65ebfdc5b0e3a4ff0b5f7b01b5cf`)

```text
For a matrix `A` with nonnegative entries, the `(i, j)`-entry of the `k`-th power `A ^ k`
is strictly positive if and only if there exists a path of length `k` from `i` to `j` in the
quiver associated to `A` via `toQuiver`. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `196bcd671e0bae80bf5676d6dbb5c87cfcddc55c113f40385f54a4d0959f2923`)

```lean
∀ {n : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [inst : Ring R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] {A : Matrix n n R} [inst_2 : Fintype n]
  [IsOrderedRing R] [PosMulStrictMono R] [Nontrivial R] [inst_6 : DecidableEq n],
  (∀ (i j : n), 0 ≤ A i j) → ∀ (k : ℕ) (i j : n), 0 < (A ^ k) i j ↔ Nonempty { p // p.length = k }
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Nat.primeCounting'`: π(n - 1) We then prove that these are monotone in `Nat.monotone_primeCounting` and `Nat.monotone_primeCounting'`. The last main theorem `Nat.primeCounting'_add_le` is an upper bound on `π'` which arises by observing that all numbers greater than `k` and not coprime to `k` are not prime, and so only at most `φ(k)/k` fraction of the numbers from `k` to `n` are prime.
```

### 精确陈述 / Exact statement

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`PhragmenLindelof.quadrant_I`, `PhragmenLindelof.quadrant_II`, `PhragmenLindelof.quadrant_III`, `PhragmenLindelof.quadrant_IV`: the Phragmen-Lindelöf principle in the coordinate quadrants;
```

#### 上游文档字符串 / Source docstring (SHA-256 `c7c3deee34853f66e27d7fc098dd05b99776e8e4c690e011db77f48899e6a10a`)

```text
**Phragmen-Lindelöf principle** in the first quadrant. Let `f : ℂ → E` be a function such that

* `f` is differentiable in the open first quadrant and is continuous on its closure;
* `‖f z‖` is bounded from above by `A * exp(B * ‖z‖ ^ c)` on the open first quadrant
  for some `c < 2`;
* `‖f z‖` is bounded from above by a constant `C` on the boundary of the first quadrant.

Then `‖f z‖` is bounded from above by the same constant on the closed first quadrant. 
```

#### 精确 Lean 类型 / Exact Lean type (SHA-256 `9aa7c76dd03403fd59790ea3b7f68f115abbd17a202b911a7991ad1f57546d1e`)

```lean
∀ {E : Type u_1} [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] [inst_1 : NormedSpace ℂ E] {C : ℝ} {f : ℂ → E} {z : ℂ},
  DiffContOnCl ℂ f (Set.Ioi 0 ×ℂ Set.Ioi 0) →
    (∃ c < 2,
        ∃ B, f =O[Bornology.cobounded ℂ ⊓ Filter.principal (Set.Ioi 0 ×ℂ Set.Ioi 0)] fun z => Real.exp (B * ‖z‖ ^ c)) →
      (∀ (x : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → ‖f ↑x‖ ≤ C) → (∀ (x : ℝ), 0 ≤ x → ‖f (↑x * Complex.I)‖ ≤ C) → 0 ≤ z.re → 0 ≤ z.im → ‖f z‖ ≤ C
```

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Field.embEquivOfAdjoinSplits`, `Field.finSepDegree_eq_of_adjoin_splits`: a random bijection between `Field.Emb F E` and `E →ₐ[F] K` if `E = F(S)` such that every element `s` of `S` is integral (= algebraic) over `F` and whose minimal polynomial splits in `K`. ```
```

```lean
∀ (F : Type u) (E : Type v) [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Field E] [inst_2 : Algebra F E] (K : Type w) [inst_3 : Field K]
  [inst_4 : Algebra F K] {S : Set E},
  IntermediateField.adjoin F S = ⊤ →
    (∀ s ∈ S, IsIntegral F s ∧ (Polynomial.map (algebraMap F K) (minpoly F s)).Splits) →
      Field.finSepDegree F E = Nat.card (E →ₐ[F] K)
```

#### 策展摘要 / Curated summary

```text
`Nat.primeCounting'`: π(n - 1) We then prove that these are monotone in `Nat.monotone_primeCounting` and `Nat.monotone_primeCounting'`. The last main theorem `Nat.primeCounting'_add_le` is an upper bound on `π'` which arises by observing that all numbers greater than `k` and not coprime to `k` are not prime, and so only at most `φ(k)/k` fraction of the numbers from `k` to `n` are prime.
```
